papers.title: Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving
papers.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference at datacenter scale is fundamentally bottlenecked by memory capacity and bandwidth limits. Because model weights are read-only and identical across instances, conventional architectures that replicate these parameters across the local DRAM of tens of thousands of accelerators incur massive capital expenditures, significant static power dissipation, and redundant memory-fetch energy. A recent proposal to use optical fiber loops as delay-line memory alleviates these issues, but its recirculating loop must hold the whole model: loop length grows with model size, slack is fixed when the ring is built, and the layouts that serve modern Mixture of Experts (MoE) models efficiently do not fit in it. We propose Optical Broadcast Memory (OBM), an open-ended hierarchical Tap-and-Amplify fiber architecture that generalizes and replaces the optical ring paradigm. A centralized memory server continuously broadcasts weights to distributed inference nodes that passively tap the data stream using receive-only co-packaged optics, delivering parameters directly to compute units without intermediate buffering. To overcome the limitations of continuous weight streaming, we use dynamically-sized slack to accommodate large and variable context lengths. We show how removing the restrictions of the optical ring allows OBM to efficiently serve MoE models. Evaluated at a datacenter scale of 80,000 accelerators, OBM eliminates petabytes of HBM while being competitive or better in throughput and energy per token than an HBM-based system.

papers.title: Towards Green Text Generation: Memory-Based Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates text generation with large language models by letting a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large verifier checks in a single forward pass. We introduce Olifant, a draft model built on a memory-based classifier. It predicts the next token from a four-token window in under 0.3 ms on CPU, requiring no GPU, no backpropagation, and no accelerator memory. We measure throughput and energy under two verifier regimes on consumer hardware. Without a KV cache, drafting is nearly free: a domain-matched Olifant model reaches 38.1% acceptance on EU legal text, delivering 2.43x throughput and 2.51x lower energy per token than the neural verifier model alone. With a KV-cached verifier, itself a ~10x energy saver, drafting costs matter: a TinyLlama draft model halves throughput and triples energy despite high acceptance, whereas Olifant still yields 1.25x throughput and the lowest energy in the study (93 J per 100 tokens, 14x below the uncached baseline). We further show that KV caching decouples time from energy: verification of longer drafts raises power draw, shifting the energy-optimal draft length below the speed-optimal one. Speculative decoding is not dead in the age of fast verifiers, provided drafting is nearly free.
papers.comment: 11 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables. Published at the 19th International Natural Language Generation Conference (INLG 2026). Code: https://github.com/antalvdb/olifant-speculative ; models: https://huggingface.co/antalvdb/olifant-speculative-ibases

papers.title: HeMeR: Heterogeneous Memory Reconciliation for Embodied Agents via Structured KV Reuse
papers.summary: Embodied agents make decisions by combining information from heterogeneous memory modules, including declarative memory for explicit knowledge, procedural memory for learned routines, and working memory for current observations. During interaction, the memory contents required for decision making change with the agent's state, goal, and task progress, while many contents remain shared across consecutive decisions. However, existing memory modules are typically accessed through separate interfaces, so each updated memory context is often processed as a new input to the foundation model. This prevents selective key-value (KV) cache reuse for unchanged memory contents and forces full KV cache recomputation even when much of the memory context remains valid. We introduce HeMeR, an inference framework that performs KV reconciliation between dynamically updated memory contexts and reusable KV states. HeMeR tracks declarative, procedural, and working memory contents across action decisions, preserves KV states for unchanged contents, and reconciles only the KV states affected by memory-content updates. This enables efficient and stable inference as memory contents evolve during interaction. We evaluate HeMeR on ALFWorld, Habitat, and real-world robotic deployments requiring coordinated use of heterogeneous memory contents. In the real-world setting, HeMeR achieves 83.20% task success and reduces per-step inference time from 2.94 to 1.87 seconds compared with MemRL, while preserving compatible KV states as task progress updates the memory context.

papers.title: FPSRG: Heterogeneous User Simulation First-Person Post-Training and Multidimensional Semantic Response Grids
papers.summary: Simulating heterogeneous individuals with large language models is an active research direction, and heterogeneous user simulation requires models with different characteristics. We study profile construction: given dimensions, items, and scoring rules, build model configurations that can be retrieved by multidimensional target scores. We introduce First-Person Semantic Response Grids (FPSRG). Shared post-training first teaches the model to judge and answer as the participant; self-report and behavioral targets then refine dimension-specific control vectors. With the model frozen, we measure joint scores for vector-coefficient combinations, filter inadmissible configurations, and store the results in a searchable catalog. Per-token configuration routing, continuous batching, and isolated caches support parallel measurement of different profiles. Non-thinking five- and ten-dimensional Qwen instances and a thinking-mode six-dimensional instance following full-parameter post-training of Huihui demonstrate the complete workflow. With matched data, layers, and norms, refinement increases mean five-axis composite control span from 30.75 to 40.45. Within the five-dimensional 25-75 target region, the qualified five-level vector catalog covers 92.2% of fixed targets under per-axis error at most 20 and total error at most 60; combining it with the prompt catalog increases coverage to 98.7%. At a fixed coefficient range, three-, five-, and nine-level catalogs achieve 71.2%, 92.2%, and 94.6% coverage, demonstrating the gains from denser measurement. These results describe measured reachable regions under a fixed assessment protocol. Through shared adaptation, a small set of learned directions, and reusable joint measurements, FPSRG constructs heterogeneous individual configurations without retraining a model for every profile.

papers.title: KVPath: Connecting Key-Value Representations Across Transformer Layers
papers.summary: Transformers typically cache an independent key-value (KV) representation for each token at every layer. Recent work reveals that a token's KV representations across neighboring layers are correlated and contain shared information. We hypothesize that this correlation implies incremental inter-layer changes, which can be effectively captured by low-dimensional deltas. Motivated by this, we propose KVPath, a new KV representation paradigm that connects KV representations across the network depth into a path. The path establishes a full-dimensional base KV at the first layer, while subsequent layers generate low-dimensional delta KVs to update the preceding KV, thereby constructing their own KV states. By caching the base KV once alongside these compact delta KVs, KVPath preserves distinct layer-specific representations without storing full KV states at every layer. We develop two variants of KVPath: KVPath-Residual, which updates vector values via residual addition, and KVPath-Rolling, which progressively updates feature dimensions in a rolling manner. Under matched parameter counts, KVPath reduces KV-cache storage by up to 68\% for Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) and 55\% for Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA), while maintaining or even improving model performance.

papers.title: TraceKV: Policy-Preserving Low-Rank KV Cache Compression for Reasoning Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) impose substantial KV cache demands from both large multimodal contexts and growing reasoning traces. Low-rank KV compression has emerged as a promising paradigm that stores low-dimensional latents of KV states and can be combined with quantization. However, existing low-rank methods often induce growing predictive policy drift from the dense model when compressing reasoning KV states, resulting in reasoning failures. We identify two key causes of this degradation: calibration-state mismatch between static contexts and on-policy reasoning states, and unequal error sensitivity across KV states. To address these challenges, we propose TraceKV, a training-free low-rank KV compression framework that unifies on-policy calibration, sensitivity-aware SVD, and global rank allocation under a single policy-preserving principle, substantially reducing policy-KL divergence during reasoning. Experiments across multiple VLMs and visual reasoning benchmarks demonstrate superior accuracy--memory trade-offs, achieving near-lossless reasoning accuracy with 5.64$\times$ KV cache compression when combined with quantization. Optimized low-rank attention kernels further deliver up to 1.83$\times$ end-to-end decoding speedup. Code will be available at https://github.com/AK-DREAM/TraceKV.

papers.title: LLMRunner: Closed Workload Model Performance Testing Framework for LLM Servings
papers.summary: Performance testing large language model (LLM) serving engines is a crucial requirement considering the criticality of the infrastructure for deploying conversational AI at scale. Most of the benchmarking tools used to carryout performance evaluation of LLM serving do not capture realistic workload orchestration unlike closed workload performance testing infrastructure used in other domains such as web and database engines. For example, state-of-the-art LLM benchmarks for performance testing model traffic as streams of independent single-turn and stand-alone requests omitting the end-user behavior such as think-time between conversational turns. We present LLMRunner, a performance tester for LLM serving that addresses this gap by providing a framework to generate realistic load consisting of multi-turn conversations with configurable end-user parameters such as number of users in the workload loop, think-time distributions etc. Moreover, LLMRunner provides declarative matrix-sweep experiment plans, integrated GPU and KV-cache monitoring, and an automated artifact collection and plotting subsystem. We use LLMRunner to comparatively analyze the performance of LLM serving when NVIDIA CUDA Unified Virtual Memory (UVM) is used as a drop-in replacement memory allocator for the Key-Value cache (KV-Cache). Our test demonstrates that UVM incurs no measurable throughput or latency penalty compared to the baseline memory allocation technique for non-oversubscription scenarios.
papers.comment: Closed-loop performance benchmarking of LLM systems

papers.title: Read Once, Answer Many: Parallel Prompting for Shared-Context LLM Inference
papers.summary: LLM workloads sometimes ask many independent questions about the same long document, as in document QA, data labeling and LLM-based evaluation. Prefix caching removes the redundant prefill shared by these queries, but each decode step still reads the document's key-value (KV) cache once per question, so decoding is bound by memory bandwidth and scales with the number of questions. We present Parallel Prompting, which decodes P questions as P independent streams of a single request all at once, fixing this issue. In our method, every step reads the shared document once for all P streams, and a stream-id attention mask, evaluated inside the attention kernel, keeps each answer conditioned only on the document and its own question. We implement Parallel Prompting in SGLang by adding about 80 lines to three existing files and a small engine package; the mask needs no dense tensor, and every decode step has a fixed shape that is captured as a CUDA graph. With CodeLlama-7B, 8k-16k-token documents and 64-256 questions per document, Parallel Prompting is 3.7x faster than stock SGLang with its FlashInfer backend on an A100 and 5.9-6.0x faster on an RTX A6000, on two SGLang releases, including the most recent release. Timed on identical inputs, it is faster than stock SGLang in all 144 runs (2 GPUs x 2 releases x 6 workloads x 6 input sets). Code: https://github.com/jlab-nlp/parallel-prompting

papers.title: Recompute or Restore? Host-Tier KV for Multi-Model Agent Workflows on a Static-Graph NPU Serving Stack
papers.summary: Agent workflows issue dependent model calls that share long context prefixes, so serving them efficiently depends on reusing the key-value (KV) cache of those prefixes. On accelerators that compile model graphs ahead of time, however, the device KV budget is fixed, and prefixes evicted under load must be recomputed. Restoring them from host memory avoids this recomputation, but the transfer occupies the same engine thread as prefill and decode, so its benefit is not guaranteed. In this paper, we study when restoring beats recomputing on a commercial static-graph neural processing unit (NPU) stack (Rebellions ATOM+, vllm-rbln 0.10.2) that serves a Qwen3-8B planner on two cards and a Qwen3-0.6B executor on one. We first show that repeated prefill dominates planner work when default serving collapses: 89.5% of the executed planner prompt tokens had been materialized before. We then build a synchronous host-DRAM tier on the runtime's public KV copy calls, together with a scheduler-aware event model whose predictions are frozen before each test cohort. Experimental results show that the host tier raises workflow service-level objective (SLO) attainment from 22.8% to 100% and from 9.4% to 99.8% in the two tested overload conditions, and endpoint confirmation on two new seeds supports conservative load gains of 11.8% (chain) and 18.2% (fork), while mixed and bursty workloads remain seed-sensitive. The frozen model predicts median and 99th-percentile (P99) latency within its 15% tolerance in all 24 common-load conditions, including the 16-18% P99 increase that the tier causes for fork workflows, but it misorders three policy contrasts and overestimates the benefit of a cheaper store path (11% predicted against 3.1% measured). The trade-off therefore depends on runtime scheduling and transfer cost as well as cache capacity.

papers.title: Edge-Native Multimodal RAG: Hardware-Aware Quantization and Architectural Optimization for Consumer GPUs
papers.summary: Deployment of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for Edge-AI is constrained by memory and bandwidth limitations. A standard 7B parameter model consumes 14 GB Video Random Access Memory (VRAM) in half-precision (FP16), precluding co-location of vector indices and Key-Value (KV) caches. This paper presents an engineering integration and empirical evaluation of a multimodal RAG framework optimized for consumer-grade Turing hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Tesla T4). Our system-level analysis identifies a critical trade-off: while generative pre-trained transformer quantization (GPTQ) offers superior throughput (51.6 tok/s), it exhibits significant context instability at 2048+ tokens on Turing architectures. Conversely, NormalFloat 4-bit (NF4) maintains robust long-context performance with viable latency (81 ms/tok). By coupling NF4 with a decoupled Florence-2 vision integration, we achieve visual reasoning with only 430 MB VRAM overhead. Furthermore, empirical observations of prompt-induced search space pruning show that structured prompting reduces latency by 47% without altering computational intensity (1.88 GFLOPs/token). The integrated architecture maintains an 8.37 GB footprint, establishing a viable RAG pipeline for 12-16 GB GPUs. Finally, structured few-shot prompting effectively compensates for quantization-induced reasoning loss, restoring mathematical accuracy from 35.0% to 92.0% across 200 trials.
papers.comment: Accepted to the 14th International Japan-Africa Conference on Electronics, Communications and Computations (JAC-ECC 2026).6 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables

papers.title: AutoAssumption: Searching over Assumptions Discovers ML-Systems Algorithms
papers.summary: Many advances in ML systems came from breaking an assumption that earlier methods took for granted: speculative decoding dropped the assumption that a model needs one forward pass per token. Yet algorithms rarely state their assumptions, so experts and discovery harnesses search over programs, where one edit changes several design choices and gains are difficult to attribute. Searching over the assumptions themselves remains largely unexplored. Writing algorithms as proofs makes their assumptions explicit and turns algorithm design into a search over a small, structured space that an LLM can explore and a proof checker can audit. We formalize 89 algorithms from KV-cache eviction, weight pruning and speculative decoding as proof graphs with explicit assumptions, checked in Lean. Our harness, AutoAssumption, relaxes one assumption of a published method, re-derives and re-proves it, and generates its code. In KV-cache eviction and weight pruning, this search improved on every published algorithm we ran and produced state-of-the-art algorithms. The eviction algorithm has the highest RULER-4K score of the published methods we ran, and the pruning algorithm the lowest perplexity of thirteen on four LLaMA models. At equal budget, the harness scores within a point of OpenEvolve, an open-source implementation of AlphaEvolve, with a lower standard deviation across repeats. Future work will formalize more fields and combine them through the principal assumptions they share.
papers.comment: 52 pages (9 main + references and appendix), 14 figures, 13 tables

papers.title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
papers.summary: Time series analytics has been widely applied across various domains. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated promising results, they still face two major challenges: 1) Most TSFMs mainly rely on stacking Transformer layers to increase parameter size, lacking the ability to adaptively model complex time series patterns from multi-domain data. 2) Current TSFMs are primarily pre-trained for specific tasks, e.g., forecasting or anomaly detection, and a few models support multiple tasks, but they fail to fully leverage task specificity and commonality, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose TimeSeek, a novel generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pre-training. Conceptually, TimeSeek is guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity. From the perspective of multi-domain data, we propose a Multi-Domain Feature Extractor that adaptively captures temporal dependencies and channel correlations based on domain-specific characteristics, including progressive multi-scale modeling and adaptive slot channel modeling. From the perspective of the diversity of tasks, we propose multi-task collaborative training, which leverages task specificity and task commonality through task customization and cross-task training, effectively unifying multiple tasks in pre-training and better adapting to diverse downstream scenarios. After pre-training on large-scale time series data, TimeSeek achieves state-of-the-art performance in forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification tasks across both few-shot learning and zero-shot situations, together with favorable inference efficiency.
papers.comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and MachineIntelligence

papers.title_zh: TimeSeek：广义时间序列分析的多任务和多域预训练
papers.summary_zh: 时间序列分析已广泛应用于各个领域。虽然现有的时间序列基础模型（TSFM）已经展示了可喜的结果，但它们仍然面临两个主要挑战：1）大多数 TSFM 主要依靠堆叠 Transformer 层来增加参数大小，缺乏从多域数据自适应地建模复杂时间序列模式的能力。 2）当前的TSFM主要针对特定​​任务进行预训练，例如预测或异常检测，并且少数模型支持多个任务，但它们未能充分利用任务的特殊性和通用性，导致性能不佳。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了 TimeSeek，这是一种新颖的广义时间序列分析模型，可以自适应地对多域数据的时间序列模式进行建模，并在预训练中统一多个任务。从概念上讲，TimeSeek 以领域和任务异构性下的选择性信息共享为指导。从多域数据的角度来看，我们提出了一种多域特征提取器，可以根据特定域的特征自适应地捕获时间依赖性和通道相关性，包括渐进式多尺度建模和自适应时隙通道建模。从任务多样性的角度出发，我们提出多任务协同训练，通过任务定制和跨任务训练，充分利用任务的特殊性和任务共性，有效统一预训练中的多个任务，更好地适应下游的多样化场景。经过大规模时间序列数据的预训练后，TimeSeek 在少样本学习和零样本情况下的预测、异常检测和分类任务中实现了最先进的性能，以及良好的推理效率。

papers.title: REAL Loss: Optimizing Real Expected Acceptance Length for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a draft model propose multiple tokens for the target model to verify in one pass. The speedup is governed by the expected acceptance length (EAL), yet standard training objectives such as cross-entropy, KL divergence, and total variation focus only on distribution matching or single-step overlap. Recent studies instead propose block-level training objectives, aiming to optimize EAL directly. However, these objectives remain surrogates rather than exact formulations of EAL. For example, some average later acceptance over target-distributed continuations rather than the verification branches selected by accepted tokens, introducing a covariance gap that can reverse the gradient direction. We analyze this gap and derive REAL, a real EAL training loss that uses path weights for unbiased estimation and Rao-Blackwellization for variance reduction. In a controlled loss-level comparison with a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and a Domino drafter, REAL outperforms WTV, VSD, DBLast, and the static LK baseline on probabilistic serving acceptance length across 9 task subsets and 5 evaluation seeds. These gains require only a change to the training loss, with no modification to the drafter architecture or inference procedure, demonstrating the practicality of real EAL training. A reference implementation of the REAL loss is available at https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss.

papers.title_zh: 真实损失：优化推测解码的真实预期接受长度
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过让草稿模型为目标模型提出多个标记来一次性验证，从而加速 LLM 推理。加速比由预期接受长度 (EAL) 决定，但交叉熵、KL 散度和总变异等标准训练目标仅关注分布匹配或单步重叠。最近的研究提出了块级训练目标，旨在直接优化 EAL。然而，这些目标仍然是 EAL 的替代目标，而不是 EAL 的精确表述。例如，对目标分布式延续而不是由接受的令牌选择的验证分支的一些平均后续接受，引入了可以反转梯度方向的协方差间隙。我们分析了这一差距并得出 REAL，这是一种真实的 EAL 训练损失，它使用路径权重进行无偏估计，并使用 Rao-Blackwellization 来减少方差。在与 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 目标和 Domino 起草者的受控损失水平比较中，REAL 在 9 个任务子集和 5 个评估种子的概率服务接受长度上优于 WTV、VSD、DBLast 和静态 LK 基线。这些收益只需要改变训练损失，无需修改绘图器架构或推理程序，证明了真正的 EAL 训练的实用性。 REAL 损失的参考实现可在 https://github.com/King-ty/speculators/tree/real-loss 获取。

papers.title: The Unused Input: The Initial State as a Conditioning Interface for Recurrent TSFMs
papers.summary: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast unseen series without task-specific training. Increasingly they are built on recurrent backbones, whose constant per-step cost makes long-context inference cheap, and which, unlike transformers, carry a state. A recurrent backbone computes its prediction from two inputs: the observed context window and the initial recurrent state. In practice only the first is utilised and the initial state is unused by convention. We ask whether the initial state can be utilised in recurrent TSFMs. Using the xLSTM-based zero-shot forecaster TiRex as a case study, we freeze the backbone and train only a small head that writes a context vector into the initial state, so that any change in accuracy is attributable to the injected state rather than to adapted weights. A spectral summary of the input window, learned once and applied unchanged to every series, lowers mean GiftEval MASE by 0.175%, with every seed improving, which neither a parameter-matched LoRA adapter nor a learnable static state reproduces. An embedding of text attached to each series, evaluated on six MoTime datasets, reveals two roles for the state. As a per-dataset adaptation surface, a static state lowers MASE by 0.04-6.96% of the zero-shot baseline (8-70% of the gain of full fine-tuning). As a channel for exogenous information, the text-conditioned state lowers it by a further 0.15-0.41% of the zero-shot baseline on four of six datasets and, combined with a LoRA adapter, exceeds full fine-tuning, which has no access to the text, on one of them. In TiRex, the effect concentrates in the mLSTM blocks and is strongest at short context. The results are preliminary and the improvements small, but they point to the initial state as a direction for further research.
papers.comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS). 21 pages

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 思路新颖但增益有限，证据尚不足以支撑高影响力。
pros: 抓住循环TSFM“初始状态未被利用”的关键空白，问题定义清晰
采用冻结主干仅训练小头的设计，较好隔离了状态注入本身的贡献
cons: 核心指标提升幅度普遍较小，实际价值与泛化收益仍不稳健
结果较依赖特定模型与数据设定，跨架构与大规模场景外推性不足

papers.title_zh: 未使用的输入：作为循环 TSFM 调节接口的初始状态
papers.summary_zh: 时间序列基础模型 (TSFM) 无需特定任务的训练即可预测看不见的序列。它们越来越多地建立在循环主干上，其恒定的每步成本使得长上下文推理变得便宜，并且与变压器不同，它带有状态。循环骨干网根据两个输入计算其预测：观察到的上下文窗口和初始循环状态。实际上，仅使用第一个，并且按照惯例不使用初始状态。我们询问初始状态是否可以在循环 TSFM 中使用。使用基于 xLSTM 的零样本预测器 TiRex 作为案例研究，我们冻结主干网络并仅训练一个将上下文向量写入初始状态的小头，因此准确性的任何变化都可归因于注入的状态而不是适应的权重。输入窗口的频谱摘要，学习一次并不变地应用于每个系列，将平均 GiftEval MASE 降低了 0.175%，每个种子都在改进，参数匹配的 LoRA 适配器和可学习的静态状态都无法重现。每个系列附加的文本嵌入在六个 MoTime 数据集上进行评估，揭示了国家的两个角色。作为每个数据集的适应表面，静态状态使 MASE 降低了零样本基线的 0.04-6.96%（完全微调增益的 8-70%）。作为外源信息的通道，文本条件状态在六个数据集中的四个上将其进一步降低了零样本基线的 0.15-0.41%，并且与 LoRA 适配器相结合，在其中一个数据集上超过了完全微调（无法访问文本）。在 TiRex 中，效果集中在 mLSTM 块中，并且在短上下文中最强。结果是初步的，改进也很小，但它们指出了初始状态作为进一步研究的方向。

papers.title: SinkState: On-the-Fly SVD of Recurrent States for Efficient Hybrid LLM Serving
papers.summary: Hybrid models combine softmax attention with linear attention, which compresses history into fixed-size recurrent states to balance model quality and inference efficiency. However, linear attention has not pushed this compression to its limit: we find that the queries, keys, and values of linear layers concentrate in a stable, low-dimensional subspace, a phenomenon we call the linear attention sink, so each state is effectively low-rank, with a rank that varies across states. Yet existing serving systems keep these redundant states dense, reading and rewriting them in full at every decoding step, so their memory traffic grows with the batch size and dominates the decoding cost. Thus SinkState stores each recurrent state in an adaptive low-rank form throughout inference with buffered updates and a local SVD restricted to the top subspace. SinkState further consolidates the remaining components asynchronously on the CPU. On four hybrid models with Mamba-2 and Gated DeltaNet (GDN) layers, from 4B to 120B parameters, SinkState reduces the peak memory of recurrent states by up to 2.6x (1.9x on average) and speeds up decoding by up to 1.58x (1.25x on average) over Mamba-SSM and FLA, while maintaining accuracy.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中瓶颈，方案实用但证据仍需加强
pros: 抓住混合线性注意力推理中状态内存带宽瓶颈，动机充分且有系统价值
提出自适应低秩状态表示与异步CPU整理，跨4B到120B模型给出较一致加速与降内存结果
cons: 摘要未交代关键开销与边界条件（SVD代价、异步调度稳定性、长序列与多负载鲁棒性），严谨性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: SinkState：用于高效混合 LLM 服务的循环状态的动态 SVD
papers.summary_zh: 混合模型将 softmax 注意力与线性注意力相结合，将历史压缩为固定大小的循环状态，以平衡模型质量和推理效率。然而，线性注意力并没有将这种压缩推向极限：我们发现线性层的查询、键和值集中在一个稳定的低维子空间中，我们将这种现象称为线性注意力池，因此每个状态实际上都是低秩的，并且各个状态的秩不同。然而，现有的服务系统使这些冗余状态保持密集，在每个解码步骤中完整地读取和重写它们，因此它们的内存流量随着批量大小而增长，并主导解码成本。因此，SinkState 在整个推理过程中以自适应低秩形式存储每个循环状态，并使用缓冲更新和仅限于顶部子空间的本地 SVD。 SinkState 进一步在 CPU 上异步整合其余组件。在具有 Mamba-2 和门控 DeltaNet (GDN) 层的四个混合模型上，从 4B 到 120B 参数，与 Mamba-SSM 和 FLA 相比，SinkState 将循环状态的峰值内存减少高达 2.6 倍（平均 1.9 倍），并将解码速度提高高达 1.58 倍（平均 1.25 倍），同时保持准确性。

papers.title: Can KV Cache Be Reused Across Model Updates? A DeepSeek-V4-Flash Case Study
papers.summary: Reusing key--value (KV) caches across language model updates could avoid repeated computation of shared context, but changes in model weights raise a fundamental question about what these caches preserve. We investigate direct cache reuse across four model updates, with a detailed study of DeepSeek-V4-Flash to Flash-0731. Our central finding is that caches can retain useful task information without faithfully reproducing the updated model's behavior. Retrieval accuracy varies substantially across updates, ranging from near-native performance to large losses. With source caches already available, reuse achieves median time-to-first-token speedups of $2.10$--$5.08\times$ on three longer-prefix QA benchmarks. To characterize the behavioral differences behind these outcomes, we introduce Functional Cache Divergence, which compares next-token distributions under reused and native caches. Direct KV cache reuse better preserves native model behavior in natural-text continuation, whereas compatibility degrades with increasing prefix length in single-token retrieval tasks. Answer-margin analyses help explain how correct retrieval decisions survive substantial internal state changes. Yet even agreement on the first generated token does not ensure agreement in answer content or stopping behavior. These findings establish task utility and fidelity to native inference as distinct criteria for evaluating cross-version KV cache reuse.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，结论有价值但外推性仍有限。
pros: 聚焦跨版本KV复用这一真实且重要的系统问题，具备明确实践价值
同时区分任务效用与行为保真，并提出FCD指标解释两者偏差，分析框架较完整

papers.title_zh: KV缓存可以跨模型更新重用吗？ DeepSeek-V4-Flash 案例研究
papers.summary_zh: 在语言模型更新中重用键值 (KV) 缓存可以避免共享上下文的重复计算，但模型权重的变化提出了一个基本问题：这些缓存保留了什么。我们研究了四个模型更新之间的直接缓存重用，并详细研究了 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 到 Flash-0731。我们的主要发现是，缓存可以保留有用的任务信息，而无需忠实地再现更新后的模型的行为。检索精度在不同的更新中差异很大，从接近本机的性能到巨大的损失。由于源缓存已经可用，重用在三个较长前缀的 QA 基准测试中实现了 $2.10$-$5.08\times$ 的中值首次令牌加速时间。为了描述这些结果背后的行为差异，我们引入了功能缓存分歧，它比较了重用和本机缓存下的下一个令牌分布。直接 KV 缓存重用可以更好地保留自然文本延续中的本机模型行为，而在单令牌检索任务中，兼容性会随着前缀长度的增加而降低。答案裕度分析有助于解释正确的检索决策如何在重大的内部状态变化中幸存下来。然而，即使就第一个生成的令牌达成一致，也不能确保在回答内容或停止行为方面达成一致。这些发现将任务实用性和对本机推理的保真度确立为评估跨版本 KV 缓存重用的独特标准。

papers.title: Scaling Shapley Energy Attribution to Large LLM Batches
papers.summary: LLM services have become essential infrastructure for applications such as chat assistants and coding agents. Service providers need to attribute resource consumption to individual requests for purposes such as billing. Among these resources, energy is a key metric for assessing the cost of serving each request. However, serving engines batch requests together, and GPUs report only aggregate energy consumption. Providers typically estimate each request's share in proportion to its token consumption, but this approach can produce substantially unfair estimates. The Shapley value provides a principled solution to fair energy allocation, but computing it directly requires $2^N-1$ GPU runs for $N$ requests, which is infeasible for large batches. To address this problem, we propose StepSplit. Across GPU generations, we observe that the energy consumed by each inference step, a forward pass over a batch, consists of a shared energy, largely due to reading model weights, and a request-specific energy. We derive a closed-form Shapley value: each request is charged its own energy plus an equal part of the shared energy of every step in which it participates. A microbenchmark of 2.5-17.8 minutes calibrates both parts of the step energy once per model and GPU configuration. Under static batching, StepSplit uses this closed form in a single pass over the scheduler log. Under continuous batching, removing a request can change how the remaining requests are batched, so StepSplit adds a correction to the closed form, computed by replaying the scheduler on a CPU. We evaluate StepSplit against Shapley values measured using 529,513 GPU runs. Under static batching with batch sizes of 8-256, StepSplit achieves an $L_1$ error of 0.4-4.3%, compared with 13.4-61.3% for token-proportional allocation. Under continuous batching with 8-128 requests, the corresponding errors are 0.5-6.4% and 20.6-71.7%.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法务实，具备顶会竞争力
pros: 将Shapley分摊从指数复杂度降为可部署流程，工程价值高
跨GPU代际建模并用52万+次GPU运行对照，实证说服力强

papers.title_zh: 将 Shapley 能量归因扩展到大型 LLM 批次
papers.summary_zh: LLM 服务已成为聊天助手和编码代理等应用程序的重要基础设施。出于计费等目的，服务提供商需要将资源消耗归因于各个请求。在这些资源中，能源是评估服务每个请求的成本的关键指标。然而，服务引擎将请求一起批处理，而 GPU 仅报告总能耗。提供商通常按照其代币消耗的比例来估计每个请求的份额，但这种方法可能会产生严重不公平的估计。 Shapley 值提供了公平能量分配的原则性解决方案，但直接计算它需要 $2^N-1$ GPU 运行 $N$ 请求，这对于大批量来说是不可行的。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了StepSplit。在各代 GPU 中，我们观察到每个推理步骤（批次的前向传递）消耗的能量由共享能量（主要是由于读取模型权重）和特定于请求的能量组成。我们推导出一个封闭式的 Shapley 值：每个请求都收取自己的能量加上其参与的每个步骤的共享能量的相等部分。 2.5-17.8 分钟的微基准可以针对每个模型和 GPU 配置校准步能量的两个部分。在静态批处理下，StepSplit 在调度程序日志的单次传递中使用这种封闭形式。在连续批处理下，删除请求可能会更改其余请求的批处理方式，因此 StepSplit 对封闭形式添加了修正，通过在 CPU 上重放调度程序来计算。我们根据使用 529,513 次 GPU 运行测量的 Shapley 值来评估 StepSplit。在批量大小为 8-256 的静态批处理下，StepSplit 的 $L_1$ 误差为 0.4-4.3%，而令牌比例分配的误差为 13.4-61.3%。在8-128个请求的连续批处理下，相应的误差为0.5-6.4%和20.6-71.7%。

papers.title: ForeSpark: Joint Draft and Verification Budget Scheduling for Parallel Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Parallel drafters accelerate LLM decoding by proposing a whole block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, making them attractive for LLM serving. Recent systems optimize goodput (i.e., accepted tokens per second) because rejected drafts steal compute from other requests. However, these systems control only how many tokens are verified, so every request still drafts a full block. At high serving load, we find that drafting consumes up to 40% of step time, of which a majority is discarded because it is never verified. Yet, draft-length control from autoregressive drafters does not carry over, because a parallel drafter commits to its length before its single pass. Moreover, draft and verification lengths are coupled across the batch, so they must be selected jointly for every request while keeping the decision computationally cheap at every step. In this paper, we propose work-conserving speculation (WCS), a design that jointly allocates draft and verification budgets per request in LLM serving, and present ForeSpark as its prototype. ForeSpark realizes WCS with (i) a context-aware pre-draft estimator that predicts acceptance for every candidate length from the target model's context features, (ii) a lightweight joint draft-verify scheduler that selects both lengths through a global sort, and (iii) a post-draft budget distribution that spends verification on the most promising tokens. Implemented on vLLM, ForeSpark improves throughput by up to 1.77x over the state-of-the-art DSpark and by 2.49x over autoregressive decoding at a matched per-request generation rate, without changing the output distribution. It also tolerates higher load, sustaining up to 1.51x the request rate of DSpark under latency service level objectives (SLOs).

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，方法实用但证据仍需补强。
pros: 提出联合草稿-验证预算调度，针对并行 speculative decoding 的关键瓶颈

papers.title_zh: ForeSpark：并行推测解码的联合草案和验证预算调度
papers.summary_zh: 并行起草者通过在单个前向传递中提出整个草案令牌块来加速 LLM 解码，这使得它们对 LLM 服务具有吸引力。最近的系统优化了有效吞吐量（即每秒接受的令牌数），因为被拒绝的草稿会窃取其他请求的计算量。然而，这些系统仅控制验证的代币数量，因此每个请求仍然会起草一个完整的块。在高服务负载下，我们发现起草消耗了高达 40% 的步骤时间，其中大部分被丢弃，因为它从未得到验证。然而，自回归牵伸机的牵伸长度控制不会继续下去，因为平行牵伸机在单次通过之前就确定了其长度。此外，草稿和验证长度在整个批次中是耦合的，因此必须为每个请求联合选择它们，同时保持每个步骤的决策计算成本低廉。在本文中，我们提出了工作节约推测（WCS），这是一种在 LLM 服务中根据请求联合分配草稿和验证预算的设计，并提出 ForeSpark 作为其原型。 ForeSpark 通过以下方式实现 WCS：(i) 上下文感知的预草案估计器，根据目标模型的上下文特征预测每个候选长度的接受程度；(ii) 轻量级联合草案验证调度程序，通过全局排序选择两个长度；以及 (iii) 草案后预算分配，用于对最有希望的令牌进行验证。 ForeSpark 在 vLLM 上实施，在匹配的每个请求生成速率下，吞吐量比最先进的 DSpark 提高了 1.77 倍，比自回归解码提高了 2.49 倍，而无需更改输出分布。它还可以承受更高的负载，在延迟服务级别目标 (SLO) 下维持 DSpark 请求速率高达 1.51 倍。

papers.title: Placing LLM Lookup Tables by Per-Layer Prefetch Deadlines
papers.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1's 203 GB of Engram n-gram tables sit in host DRAM today, taking 190 of the 223 GiB a 4-GPU serving process uses. Row indices depend only on input tokens, so reads can start with each step and overlap earlier layers. V4.1's two Engram layers have windows that differ by 30x (0.3 vs. 9.3 ms). We show that this deadline, together with session reuse and contention on a shared device, decides which tier each table can use and which layers need cache, and we give a model that predicts the resulting slowdown from measured read times. Agent and chat traffic reuse rows within sessions, and static hot sets transfer poorly. We build SlackTier, a table tier for SGLang that issues all lookups at step start. It reads the short-window layer first and splits a small GPU row cache across layers. The path runs inside the decode CUDA graph and is bit-exact with the original gather. Layer 14's table can go to NVMe uncached with no measurable decode cost. With both tables on four NVMe disks, mean time per output token on agent and chat replays rises at most 1.4% over unmodified SGLang, and host memory falls from 212 to 34 GiB. Both tables need no cache when read over RDMA (remote direct memory access) from another node's memory; one copy serves two instances. On a KV-constrained agent workload, using the freed memory as host KV cache at the same memory budget raises median throughput by 36% and cuts median p90 time to first token from 38 to 24 s.

quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，工程价值高且证据较充分。
pros: 提出按层预取截止期进行表分层放置，机制与性能模型结合紧密
在真实SGLang路径实现位精确集成，并给出显著内存回收与端到端收益
cons: 结果主要基于单模型与回放负载，跨模型泛化和在线长尾稳定性仍需更强验证

papers.title_zh: 按每层预取截止时间放置 LLM 查找表
papers.summary_zh: 目前，DeepSeek-V4.1 的 203 GB Engram n-gram 表位于主机 DRAM 中，占用了 4-GPU 服务进程使用的 223 GiB 中的 190 个。行索引仅取决于输入标记，因此读取可以从每个步骤开始并重叠较早的层。 V4.1 的两个 Engram 层的窗口相差 30 倍（0.3 与 9.3 毫秒）。我们表明，这个截止日期以及共享设备上的会话重用和争用决定了每个表可以使用哪一层以及哪些层需要缓存，并且我们给出了一个模型，该模型可以根据测量的读取时间来预测由此产生的速度减慢。代理和聊天流量在会话内重用行，静态热集传输效果不佳。我们构建了 SlackTier，这是 SGLang 的一个表层，它在步骤开始时发出所有查找。它首先读取短窗口层，然后跨层分割一个小的 GPU 行缓存。该路径在解码 CUDA 图内运行，并且与原始收集是位精确的。第 14 层的表可以不缓存地进入 NVMe，无需可测量的解码成本。两个表都位于四个 NVMe 磁盘上时，代理和聊天重放上每个输出令牌的平均时间比未修改的 SGLang 最多增加 1.4%，并且主机内存从 212 GiB 下降到 34 GiB。当从另一个节点的内存通过 RDMA（远程直接内存访问）读取时，两个表都不需要缓存；一份副本可用于两个实例。在 KV 约束的代理工作负载上，在相同内存预算下使用释放的内存作为主机 KV 缓存可将吞吐量中值提高 36%，并将第一个令牌的 p90 时间中值从 38 秒缩短到 24 秒。

papers.title: Looping Deeper Without Growing the KV Cache: Recurrent Depth for Causal Encoder-Decoders
papers.summary: Looped language models deepen computation without adding parameters, yet caching full-context key-value (KV) states across layers and rounds severely bounds serving batch size. We design a looped causal encoder-decoder (CED) that achieves recurrent depth with zero round-wise KV growth, addressing where and how to loop an asymmetric stack in which only sparse encoder layers generate global KV. We find that recurrence must be placed in the encoder to iteratively refine global KV representations rather than re-reading static decoder projections, which both drives language-modeling gains and preserves long-context scaling. Furthermore, training the encoder loop under stochastic recurrence depth induces a fixed-point equilibrium where every round losslessly shares the last round's KV cache. Compounding cross-layer and cross-round KV sharing, the resulting Looped CED matches an unlooped CED's minimal memory footprint and recovers 86-93% of a looped Transformer's gain with 1/6 of its global KV. To test serving at production scale, we loop the 552B-parameter DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash for 8 rounds on one 4xGB200 node: with per-layer and per-round KV the loop cannot fit a single 128K-token request, whereas Looped CED holds 36.8x less KV per token, fits 38 such requests (as many as the unlooped model), and serves 3.6x higher throughput on 8K-token prompts.
papers.comment: 23 pages (11 pages main text), 10 figures, 14 tables

papers.title_zh: 在不增加 KV 缓存的情况下循环更深：因果编码器-解码器的循环深度
papers.summary_zh: 循环语言模型无需添加参数即可加深计算，但跨层和轮次缓存全上下文键值 (KV) 状态会严重限制服务批量大小。我们设计了一种循环因果编码器-解码器（CED），它以零循环 KV 增长实现循环深度，解决了在何处以及如何循环非对称堆栈（其中仅稀疏编码器层生成全局 KV）的问题。我们发现必须将循环放在编码器中以迭代地细化全局 KV 表示，而不是重新读取静态解码器投影，这既可以驱动语言建模增益，又可以保留长上下文缩放。此外，在随机递归深度下训练编码器循环会产生定点平衡，其中每一轮无损地共享上一轮的 KV 缓存。结合跨层和跨轮 KV 共享，生成的 Looped CED 与未循环 CED 的最小内存占用相匹配，并以其全局 KV 的 1/6 恢复了循环 Transformer 增益的 86-93%。为了测试生产规模的服务，我们在一个 4xGB200 节点上将 552B 参数 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 循环 8 轮：对于每层和每轮 KV，循环无法满足单个 128K 令牌请求，而 Looped CED 每个令牌的 KV 减少 36.8 倍，适合 38 个此类请求（与未循环模型一样多），并在 3.6 倍的吞吐量上提供更高的吞吐量8K 令牌提示。

papers.title: Decode Token Parallelism: Memory-Efficient Distributed Attention Parallelism for Scalable LLM Decoding
papers.summary: Serving large language models at high concurrency with long contexts requires KV-cache capacity and attention bandwidth that grow with the decode pool. Existing parallelization strategies trade one against the other: data parallelism replicates model weights, limiting KV capacity; tensor parallelism stops scaling attention at the model's KV-head count and pushes dense collectives across nodes; and decode context parallelism (DCP) recovers capacity by sharding the sequence but adds cross-node aggregation of partial attention results. We observe that during decode, dense layers and attention scale differently: dense layers amortize weight reads across the batch and run efficiently within a single NVLink domain, whereas attention cost grows with every active request's KV cache. We present Decode Token Parallelism (TKNP), a decode-pool architecture that decouples weight placement from attention ownership. TKNP distributes a single model copy across nodes in balanced layer blocks. The active node holding a block executes its projections and MLP for the full batch using intra-node tensor parallelism, while every node computes attention for its own requests against locally resident KV cache. This extends request-local attention across nodes without replicating weights: only current-token activations cross the network, dense all-reduces remain within NVLink, and attention requires no cross-node merging of partial results. Implemented in vLLM and evaluated on Llama 3.1 405B and Nemotron-4 340B on up to 64 H100 GPUs, TKNP improves completion throughput for long-context, high-concurrency workloads by up to 1.7$\times$ over DCP and by up to 2.06$\times$ over data parallelism at matched GPU count.

papers.title_zh: 解码令牌并行性：用于可扩展 LLM 解码的内存高效分布式注意力并行性
papers.summary_zh: 以长上下文高并发地服务大型语言模型需要 KV 缓存容量和注意力带宽，这些容量和注意力带宽会随着解码池的增长而增长。现有的并行化策略相互矛盾：数据并行复制模型权重，限制 KV 容量；张量并行性停止了对模型 KV 头数的扩展注意力，并推动跨节点的密集集合；解码上下文并行性（DCP）通过对序列进行分片来恢复容量，但增加了部分注意力结果的跨节点聚合。我们观察到，在解码过程中，密集层和注意力规模不同：密集层分摊整个批次的权重读取并在单个 NVLink 域内高效运行，而注意力成本随着每个活动请求的 KV 缓存而增长。我们提出了解码令牌并行性（TKNP），这是一种解码池架构，可将权重放置与注意力所有权分离。 TKNP 在平衡层块中的节点之间分配单个模型副本。持有区块的主动节点使用节点内张量并行性执行整个批次的投影和 MLP，而每个节点针对本地驻留的 KV 缓存计算自己的请求的注意力。这将请求本地注意力扩展到节点之间，而无需复制权重：只有当前令牌激活穿过网络，密集的全归约保留在 NVLink 内，并且注意力不需要部分结果的跨节点合并。 TKNP 在 vLLM 中实施，并在最多 64 个 H100 GPU 上的 Llama 3.1 405B 和 Nemotron-4 340B 上进行了评估，在匹配的 GPU 数量下，与 DCP 相比，TKNP 提高了长上下文、高并发工作负载的完成吞吐量高达 1.7$\times$，比数据并行度提高了高达 2.06$\times$。

papers.title: One-Sided Expert-Parallel All-to-All for Mixture-of-Experts Inference over NVLink
papers.summary: Expert parallelism (EP) shards the experts of a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layer across GPUs, so every MoE layer requires two all-to-all communications, namely dispatch and combine. Compared with training, inference processes relatively few tokens per GPU at a time, and at small batch sizes fixed costs that do not grow with the number of tokens, rather than data movement, dominate the latency. We present NVLinkOneSided, a one-sided EP all-to-all for GPUs within a single NVLink domain. Each source rank pushes its tokens, without first exchanging metadata, into rank-major buffers on the target GPUs, and the grouped GEMMs read them in place instead of from a per-expert copy. We provide two protocols for the synchronization that the communication requires, namely Fence and Sentinel, for high-throughput and low-latency scenarios respectively. On Blackwell GPUs, NVLinkOneSided completes dispatch and combine 1.2-3.0$\times$ faster than DeepEP, with the largest speedups at small batch sizes. The resulting MoE layer is up to 2.4$\times$ faster than DeepEP with DeepGEMM. It even outperforms the fused DeepGEMM MegaMoE at up to 128 tokens per GPU, making it still competitive for decoding. We expose NVLinkOneSided through a modular interface, so that it is agnostic to the activation quantization format, decoupled from the MoE compute backend and easy to integrate into inference frameworks.

papers.title_zh: 通过 NVLink 进行专家混合推理的单侧专家并行全对全
papers.summary_zh: 专家并行 (EP) 将专家混合 (MoE) 层的专家跨 GPU 分片，因此每个 MoE 层都需要两次全对全通信，即调度和组合。与训练相比，推理每次每个 GPU 处理相对较少的令牌，并且在小批量大小时，固定成本（不随令牌数量而增长）主导延迟，而不是数据移动。我们推出了 NVLinkOneSided，这是一种单向 EP，适用于单个 NVLink 域内的 GPU。每个源等级将其令牌推送到目标 GPU 上的等级主要缓冲区中，而无需首先交换元数据，并且分组的 GEMM 就地读取它们，而不是从每个专家的副本中读取它们。我们提供了两种通信所需的同步协议，即Fence和Sentinel，分别针对高吞吐量和低延迟场景。在 Blackwell GPU 上，NVLinkOneSided 完成调度和组合的速度比 DeepEP 快 1.2-3.0$\times$，并且在小批量大小下具有最大的加速。由此产生的 MoE 层比采用 DeepGEMM 的 DeepEP 快 2.4$\times$。它甚至优于融合的 DeepGEMM MegaMoE，每个 GPU 最多 128 个令牌，使其在解码方面仍然具有竞争力。我们通过模块化接口公开 NVLinkOneSided，因此它与激活量化格式无关，与 MoE 计算后端解耦，并且易于集成到推理框架中。

papers.title: SHADOWPREFILL: Keeping Your Next Model Warm for Per-Step Model Routing in Agentic LLM Serving
papers.summary: Per-step model routers send each LLM call of an agent to the cost-optimal model dynamically within each session. However, every model switch discards prefix-cache reuse: KV caches are per model, so the new model must prefill the relevant context before it emits a token. Across representative agentic workloads, including a production coding-agent trace with a mean context of 63K tokens, the prefix hit rate falls from 80-89% on same model calls to 44-65% after a switch, and a switch call takes 1.5-3.2x as long. We present SHADOWPREFILL, which prefills the session's context on the model the router has not chosen, in capacity that instances serving normal traffic leave idle, so the next switch finds its prefix cached. SHADOWPREFILL harvests the per-iteration SLO slack of requests in flight, protects routed calls, spills shadow KV to host memory, and falls back to a cold switch whenever the shadow is incomplete. With LLMRouter routing 24 model pairs over five agentic benchmark suites, SHADOWPREFILL cuts switch-call latency by 8.5-21.4%, LLM-call latency by 3.7-17.7%, and routed token cost by 22.5-46.1%, while normal traffic keeps its SLO and energy per request rises by 0.4%.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案实用且结果可观

系统设计完整（SLO余量利用、主机溢出、冷切换回退），并在多模型对与多基准上展示一致收益

papers.title_zh: SHADOWPREFILL：为代理 LLM 服务中的每步模型路由保持下一个模型的温暖
papers.summary_zh: 每步模型路由器在每个会话中动态地将代理的每个 LLM 调用发送到成本最优模型。然而，每个模型切换都会放弃前缀缓存重用：KV 缓存是每个模型的，因此新模型必须在发出令牌之前预填充相关上下文。在代表性的代理工作负载中，包括具有 63K 令牌平均上下文的生产编码代理跟踪，前缀命中率从相同模型调用的 80-89% 下降到切换后的 44-65%，并且切换调用需要 1.5-3.2 倍的时间。我们提出了 SHADOWPREFILL，它在路由器未选择的模型上预填充会话上下文，其容量使服务正常流量的实例保持空闲状态，以便下一个交换机发现其前缀被缓存。 SHADOWPREFILL 收集运行中请求的每迭代 SLO 松弛，保护路由调用，将影子 KV 溢出到主机内存，并在影子不完整时回退到冷切换。通过 LLMRouter 在五个代理基准套件上路由 24 个模型对，SHADOWPREFILL 将切换调用延迟减少了 8.5-21.4%，LLM 调用延迟减少了 3.7-17.7%，路由令牌成本减少了 22.5-46.1%，而正常流量保持其 SLO，每个请求的能量增加了 0.4%。

papers.title: Inference Validation for Regulated AI: A Governed Decision Pipeline for LLM Serving
papers.summary: Deploying large language models in regulated industries requires more than picking the fastest inference engine: it requires evidence that a configuration meets contractual and legal obligations before it serves a single customer request. We describe Runway, an internal validation harness built at MasterControl that builds a governed decision pipeline around NVIDIA AIPerf. The key insight is separating concerns: AIPerf provides the trusted measurement, while Runway provides the experiment design that comes before it and the compliance, cost, and audit decisions that come after. We describe the architecture and the storage model that makes caching and audit one mechanism. We report three findings from Runway sweeps: TensorRT-LLM and vLLM rankings invert with concurrency; a newer, pricier GPU instance can be the cheaper one per request; and speculative decoding behaves differently across engines under load, so engine configuration can outweigh engine choice.
papers.comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables Updated paper title to better reflect content

papers.title_zh: 受监管 AI 的推理验证：在 NVIDIA AIPerf 上构建决策管道
papers.summary_zh: 在受监管的行业中部署大型语言模型需要的不仅仅是选择最快的推理引擎：它需要证据证明配置在满足单个客户请求之前满足合同和法律义务。我们描述了 Runway，这是一个在 MasterControl 上构建的内部验证工具，它围绕 NVIDIA AIPerf 构建了一个受管理的决策管道。关键的见解是分离关注点：AIPerf 提供可信的测量，而 Runway 提供之前的实验设计以及之后的合规性、成本和审计决策。我们描述了使缓存和审核成为一种机制的架构和存储模型。我们报告了 Runway 扫描的三项发现：TensorRT-LLM 和 vLLM 排名随并发性反转；对于每个请求来说，更新、价格较高的 GPU 实例可能会更便宜；不同引擎在负载下的推测解码行为也不同，因此引擎配置可能比引擎选择更重要。

papers.title: Phrase-Level Speculative Decoding on a Frozen Target
papers.summary: Speculative decoders raise throughput by banking more target tokens per forward pass, and Medusa, EAGLE-3, DFlash and DSpark all do it the same way: more candidates that survive verification. All of them draft in the target's own vocabulary, so one node of the candidate tree is one target token, and the tokenizer makes that unit look like a constant. It is not. BPE's pretokenizer splits on whitespace before merges are learned, so no multi-word string can ever become a single token: in Qwen3-4B, "United States of America" is four tokens and no adjacent pair of them exists as one entry, so a phrase is out of reach of any method drafting in the target's vocabulary. We change the unit. A small MLP head reads the frozen target's hidden state and predicts a one- to three-word phrase as one entry in a separate draft vocabulary; greedy longest-match expansion maps it back into the target's own tokens, and N candidates are verified in one forward pass behind a prefix-tree mask, so the change is orthogonal to tree depth and width. The target and its tokenizer stay frozen and a candidate is accepted only while it matches the target's own argmax, so the served output is identical to greedy decoding up to floating-point tie-breaking. On one A5000 at batch 1, against HuggingFace generate(), a 21.94M head (0.545% of Qwen3-4B) reaches 2.391x on GSM8K, 2.444x on MATH-500 and 1.544x on MT-Bench. Because the head's output layer is one row of 257 parameters per entry, the draft vocabulary size is the parameter budget: an 8,000-entry head is 3.434M parameters, 0.0854% of the target and 64x smaller than EAGLE-3's drafter, and keeps 92.3% of the larger head's GSM8K tokens per pass. With EAGLE-3 run on same prompts and baseline, our 21.94M head is ahead of tree-16 on both maths sets and behind tree-60 on every set.

papers.title_zh: 对冻结目标的短语级推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码器通过在每次前向传递中存储更多目标令牌来提高吞吐量，Medusa、EAGLE-3、DFlash 和 DSpark 都以相同的方式做到这一点：更多的候选者能够通过验证。它们都使用目标自己的词汇表起草，因此候选树的一个节点是一个目标标记，并且标记器使该单元看起来像一个常量。它不是。 BPE 的预分词器在学习合并之前会在空格上进行分割，因此多单词字符串永远不会成为单个标记：在 Qwen3-4B 中，“United States of America”是四个标记，并且它们之间不存在作为一个条目的相邻对，因此在目标词汇表中任何方法起草都无法访问短语。我们改变单位。一个小的 MLP 头读取冻结目标的隐藏状态，并预测一到三个单词的短语作为单独草稿词汇表中的一个条目；贪婪的最长匹配扩展将其映射回目标自己的令牌，并且在前缀树掩码后面的一次前向传递中验证 N 个候选者，因此该变化与树的深度和宽度正交。目标及其分词器保持冻结状态，并且仅当候选者与目标自己的 argmax 匹配时才接受候选者，因此所提供的输出与浮点平局决胜之前的贪婪解码相同。在第 1 批的一台 A5000 上，针对 HuggingFacegenerate()，21.94M 头（Qwen3-4B 的 0.545%）在 GSM8K 上达到 2.391x，在 MATH-500 上达到 2.444x，在 MT-Bench 上达到 1.544x。由于 head 的输出层是每个条目 257 个参数的一行，因此草案词汇表大小就是参数预算：8,000 个条目的 head 是 3.434M 参数，是目标的 0.0854%，比 EAGLE-3 的起草者小 64 倍，并且每次传递保留较大 head 的 GSM8K 令牌的 92.3%。当 EAGLE-3 在相同的提示和基线上运行时，我们的 21.94M 头在两个数学集上都领先于tree-16，在每组上都落后于tree-60。

papers.title: DForkTree: Accelerating Speculative Decoding with Fork-Aware Block Diffusion Draft Trees
papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up language models by having a lightweight drafter propose future tokens that the target model verifies in parallel. Block diffusion drafters such as DFlash predict an entire block in one forward pass, and DDTree builds draft trees directly from their per-position distributions. Each distribution implicitly assumes that the drafter's own greedy continuation is accepted, whereas a draft tree improves over a chain only on branches that leave this greedy path. Once a path forks, the drafter's top-1 accuracy drops from 89% to 18% and its top candidates often miss the true token. Re-running the drafter from the fork token largely restores its accuracy, showing that the errors stem from conditioning on an outdated prefix rather than from limited model capacity. In this paper, we introduce DForkTree, a training-free method that re-anchors each branch on its own tokens. It adjusts the drafter's scores with pointwise mutual information from target-generated n-grams, weighted more heavily after a fork, and a layer-wise GPU search recovers the exact optimal tree under these scores. On Qwen3.5-4B and 9B, DForkTree outperforms all baselines on every benchmark, by up to 41.5% over DFlash and 15.1% over DDTree, with average speedups of up to 4.75x over autoregressive decoding.

papers.title_zh: DForkTree：使用分叉感知块扩散草案树加速推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过让轻量级起草者提出目标模型并行验证的几个未来标记来加速语言模型。块扩散起草器（例如 DFlash）在一次前向传递中起草整个块，而 DDTree 根据其每个位置的分布构建一棵草图树。这些分布中的每一个都假设起草者自己最有可能的延续是正确的。然而，一棵树仅在离开此延续的分支上优于链，其中起草者的 top-1 准确度从 89% 下降到 18%，并且其候选列表更频繁地错过正确的标记。当从分叉令牌重新运行时，同一个起草者通常是正确的，因此错误来自分布所依据的前缀，而不是来自起草者所知道的。我们引入了 DForkTree，这是一种无需训练的方法，可以将每个分支重新锚定在自己的标记上。 DForkTree 将目标模型自身输出的 n 元语法统计数据作为逐点互信息添加到起草者的分数中，在分叉后对它们进行更多加权，并在 GPU 上准确地根据这些分数构建最优树。在 Qwen3.5-4B 和 9B 上，所有树方法共享一个起草器、树管道和验证器，DForkTree 是每个基准测试中最快的树方法。在相同设置下，它比 DFlash 快 41.5%，比 DDTree 快 15.1%，平均加速比自回归解码高达 4.75 倍。

papers.title: Evolving Infra: Agent-Adaptive LLM Serving at Scale
papers.summary: Agentic workloads are a major source of LLM inference demand. Existing prefill--decode (PD) disaggregated serving systems offer limited flexibility for runtime adaptation of compute allocation and KV cache management, and rely on coarse signals that only partly capture the diverse and dynamic agent workload. These limitations lead to load imbalance between prefill and decode nodes and eviction of KV caches that agents will reuse. We present Evolving Infra, an agent-adaptive serving framework that adapts compute allocation to agent workloads and KV cache management to agent context management at runtime. We decouple compute allocation from key--value (KV) cache management, allowing nodes to switch efficiently between prefill and decode. Building on this design, an online planner matches the PD split to workload composition, while an agent-aware distributed KV manager guides cache eviction and transfer with signals from agent context management. Across coding, math, and computer-use tasks with GLM-5.2 and Kimi K2.6 on up to 256 GB300 GPUs, Evolving Infra reduces mean end-to-end request latency and P95 TTFT by up to 4.1x and 14x over Dynamo, NVIDIA's production framework. We open-source the system implementation of Evolving Infra at https://github.com/mit-han-lab/EvolvingInfra.

papers.title_zh: 不断发展的基础设施：大规模服务的代理自适应法学硕士
papers.summary_zh: 代理工作负载是 LLM 推理需求的主要来源。现有的预填充-解码 (PD) 分解服务系统为计算分配和 KV 缓存管理的运行时适应提供了有限的灵活性，并且依赖于仅部分捕获多样化和动态代理工作负载的粗略信号。这些限制导致预填充和解码节点之间的负载不平衡，并驱逐代理将重用的 KV 缓存。我们提出了 Evolving Infra，这是一个代理自适应服务框架，可以在运行时根据代理工作负载调整计算分配，并根据代理上下文管理调整 KV 缓存管理。我们将计算分配与键值 (KV) 缓存管理解耦，允许节点在预填充和解码之间高效切换。在此设计的基础上，在线规划器将 PD 拆分与工作负载组合相匹配，而代理感知的分布式 KV 管理器则通过代理上下文管理的信号来指导缓存逐出和传输。在高达 256 GB300 GPU 上使用 GLM-5.2 和 Kimi K2.6 执行编码、数学和计算机使用任务时，Evolving Infra 与 NVIDIA 的生产框架 Dynamo 相比，将平均端到端请求延迟和 P95 TTFT 分别降低了 4.1 倍和 14 倍。

papers.title: RecoGEM: A Serving System for Production-Scale Generative Recommendation
papers.summary: Generative recommendation (GR) is moving industrial recommender systems (RecSys) from scoring candidate items to autoregressively generating item identifiers. This shift promises higher recommendation quality, but makes serving substantially harder: each request executes a short sequence of dependent decoding steps that explore a large item space and select promising candidates on the latency-critical path. GR not only creates structural mismatches with conventional RecSys pipelines, but also challenges the architectural and optimization assumptions of LLM serving stacks, making direct adoption of existing systems difficult. We present RecoGEM, our production GR serving system. RecoGEM uses a runtime--engine decoupling architecture to move GR-specific serving responsibilities, such as candidate-state transitions and live artifact updates, to a dedicated runtime. Its execution engine exploits GR's short token sequences, large candidate populations, and predictable step shapes to optimize self-attention, candidate selection, and execution planning. RecoGEM has been deployed for over nine months across our production lines, serving applications with hundreds of millions of users and supporting more than ten GR model families. On our OneModel production workloads, RecoGEM reaches over 1,000 QPS per serving instance with P99 latency below 35 ms and a 2.88$\times$ throughput improvement over representative baselines.

papers.title_zh: RecoGEM：用于生产规模生成推荐的服务系统
papers.summary_zh: 生成推荐 (GR) 正在将工业推荐系统 (RecSys) 从对候选项目进行评分转向自回归生成项目标识符。这种转变保证了更高的推荐质量，但使服务变得更加困难：每个请求都会执行一个短序列的相关解码步骤，这些步骤探索大型项目空间并在延迟关键路径上选择有希望的候选者。 GR 不仅造成与传统 RecSys 管道的结构不匹配，而且挑战了 LLM 服务堆栈的架构和优化假设，使得直接采用现有系统变得困难。我们推出 RecoGEM，我们的生产 GR 服务系统。 RecoGEM 使用运行时-引擎解耦架构将 GR 特定的服务职责（例如候选状态转换和实时工件更新）转移到专用运行时。其执行引擎利用 GR 的短令牌序列、大量候选群体和可预测的步骤形状来优化自注意力、候选选择和执行计划。 RecoGEM 已在我们的生产线上部署了九个多月，为数亿用户的应用程序提供服务，并支持十多个 GR 模型系列。在我们的 OneModel 生产工作负载上，RecoGEM 每个服务实例的 QPS 超过 1,000，P99 延迟低于 35 毫秒，吞吐量比代表性基准提高了 2.88 美元\次$。

papers.title: Translating KV Caches Between Hybrid-Attention Language Models: MLA Latents, Linear-Attention States and Sparse-Attention Indexers
papers.summary: A model that takes over another model's conversation must normally re-read the whole history; a text hand-off shortens the re-read only by dropping content. KV-cache translation instead maps the source's cache into the target's own format, so the target continues from the full context without re-reading it. It works for grouped-query attention (GQA), but open-weights frontier models now cache compressed latents (MLA), sparse-attention indexer keys and fixed-size linear-attention states. We replicate KV-Lingo on a GQA pair and then give, for each of these objects, where to capture and inject it and a mechanism that reaches native quality. We study two hybrid pairs at 16-48B scale in both directions, Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B (MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention) and Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B (Gated DeltaNet hybrids), plus a sparse-attention target (Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). MLA latents translate with token-wise linear maps; recurrent states are copied with a closed-form correction or synthesised by replaying the target's own recurrence. Exact long-range recall needs token identity: decoding token ids from the source's layer-0 MLA latent raises needle recall from 0.09 to 0.99 at 2-32K and to 0.83-1.00 at 64K, eight times the longest training prompt. The hybrid full-MLA direction is within the paired confidence interval of native quality on every task metric, and same-shape GDN hybrids reach the native level in both directions (apart from 6% refusals inherited from the source), with time to first token 18.7 and 46.8 times shorter than a re-read at 64K tokens. Segment-wise multi-turn transfer stays at the re-prefill level; naive re-translation collapses. On the sparse-attention target, predicted indexer keys recall the needle as well as the target's own keys (one seed). We state as a hypothesis how the recipes transfer to 300B+ hybrid flagships.

papers.title_zh: 在混合注意力语言模型之间转换 KV 缓存：MLA 潜在、线性注意力状态和稀疏注意力索引器
papers.summary_zh: 接管另一个模型对话的模型通常必须重新读取整个历史记录；文本传递仅通过删除内容来缩短重新阅读的时间。 KV-cache translation instead maps the source's cache into the target's own format, so the target continues from the full context without re-reading it. It works for grouped-query attention (GQA), but open-weights frontier models now cache compressed latents (MLA), sparse-attention indexer keys and fixed-size linear-attention states. We replicate KV-Lingo on a GQA pair and then give, for each of these objects, where to capture and inject it and a mechanism that reaches native quality. We study two hybrid pairs at 16-48B scale in both directions, Kimi-VL-A3B - Kimi-Linear-48B (MLA - MLA + Kimi Delta Attention) and Qwen3.5-27B - Qwen3.8-27B (Gated DeltaNet hybrids), plus a sparse-attention target (Qwen3.8-27B - Qwen3.8-Flash-Next). MLA 潜伏与 token-wise 线性映射进行转换；循环状态通过封闭形式校正进行复制或通过重放目标自身的循环来合成。 Exact long-range recall needs token identity: decoding token ids from the source's layer-0 MLA latent raises needle recall from 0.09 to 0.99 at 2-32K and to 0.83-1.00 at 64K, eight times the longest training prompt. The hybrid full-MLA direction is within the paired confidence interval of native quality on every task metric, and same-shape GDN hybrids reach the native level in both directions (apart from 6% refusals inherited from the source), with time to first token 18.7 and 46.8 times shorter than a re-read at 64K tokens.分段多转传输保持在重新预填充水平；天真的重新翻译崩溃了。在稀疏注意力目标上，预测的索引器键会回忆起针以及目标自己的键（一粒种子）。我们假设配方如何转移到 300B+ 混合旗舰。

papers.title: Infrathon: Benchmarking Language Agents for Real-World, Long-Horizon AI Infra Optimization
papers.summary: In this work, we study whether frontier agent can continually improve real-world AI infrastructure over long horizons. We introduce Infrathon, a benchmark of diverse, long-horizon AI infrastructure optimization tasks across different levels. We evaluate six models across 150 runs with 24-hour budgets, totaling over 10,000 GPU-hours. Our results show that model rankings vary with the evaluation horizon, while 135 of the 150 runs achieve further improvements during the second half of their budgets. These findings indicate that shorter evaluations can overlook both optimization gains and changes in relative model performance. We also find agents can discover solutions that outperform human-designed baselines: Claude Opus 5.5 increases the mean KV-cache compression ratio from 6.82% with the human-designed Quant-VideoGen codec to 19.86%. Analysis of agent trajectories identifies task violations, unreliable testing, and premature completion as barriers to sustained improvement. Together, Our Infrathon framework provide resources for constructing long-horizon tasks, evaluating frontier agents, and discovering good infrastructure solutions.

papers.title_zh: Infrathon：针对现实世界、长期人工智能基础设施优化的语言代理基准测试
papers.summary_zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究前沿智能体是否能够长期持续改进现实世界的人工智能基础设施。我们推出了 Infrathon，这是跨不同级别的多样化、长期人工智能基础设施优化任务的基准。我们在 24 小时预算内评估了 150 次运行中的 6 个模型，总计超过 10,000 个 GPU 小时。我们的结果表明，模型排名随评估范围的不同而变化，而 150 次运行中有 135 次在预算的后半段实现了进一步的改进。这些发现表明，较短的评估可能会忽略优化收益和相对模型性能的变化。我们还发现代理可以发现优于人工设计基准的解决方案：Claude Opus 5.5 将人工设计的 Quant-VideoGen 编解码器的平均 KV 缓存压缩率从 6.82% 提高到 19.86%。对代理轨迹的分析发现任务违规、不可靠的测试和过早完成是持续改进的障碍。总之，我们的 Infrathon 框架为构建长期任务、评估前沿代理和发现良好的基础设施解决方案提供了资源。

papers.title: Multi-Future Drafting: Mixture Block Drafters for Tree-Verified Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Block drafters such as DFlash draft a block of future tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees such as DDTree verify the prefixes ranked highest by the product of the drafter's per-position distributions. Under tree verification, the expected number of accepted tokens is the probability mass the tree covers. We show that a product misallocates it: when the continuation can follow several futures, it splices them into chimeras, prefixes stitched together from different futures that the target never produces, and gives them as much budget as the futures themselves. Barring ties, no product-ranked tree can hold two futures that disagree in $m$ positions without $2^{m-1}-1$ chimeras, however well the drafter is trained, and in practice chimeras make up 27-33% of a 64-node tree. We propose Multi-Future Drafting (MFD), which restores the coupling with a latent variable instead of the chain rule: $K$ learned mode embeddings at the drafter's input draft $K$ coherent blocks in the same pass, and a mixture DDTree lets the verifier pick the future the target takes, losslessly and with $K+1$ extra vectors. On four Qwen targets from 4B to 27B parameters, at batch size 1, MFD reaches up to 7.8$\times$ speedup, 5-8% faster than the best single-mode tree trained identically and, on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B, 9-16% faster than the released DARTree trained on the same prompts.

papers.title_zh: 多未来绘图：用于树验证推测解码的混合块绘图器
papers.summary_zh: 区块起草者（例如 DFlash）在一次前向传递中起草未来代币的区块，而起草树（例如 DDTree）则验证根据起草者的每个位置分布的乘积排名最高的前缀。在树验证下，预期接受的令牌数量是树覆盖的概率质量。我们证明了一个产品错误地分配了它：当延续可以遵循多个期货时，它将它们拼接成嵌合体，即从目标从未产生的不同期货缝合在一起的前缀，并为它们提供与期货本身一样多的预算。除非有平局，否则任何产品排名树都不能在没有 $2^{m-1}-1$ 嵌合体的情况下持有两个在 $m$ 位置上不一致的期货，无论起草者训练有素，实际上，嵌合体占 64 节点树的 27-33%。我们提出了多重未来起草（MFD），它恢复了与潜在变量而不是链式规则的耦合：$K$在起草者的输入草稿中学习模式嵌入在同一通道中$K$连贯块，并且混合DDTree让验证者无损地选择目标所采用的未来，并带有$K+1$额外向量。在从 4B 到 27B 参数的四个 Qwen 目标上，批量大小为 1 时，MFD 加速高达 7.8$\times$，比相同训练的最佳单模式树快 5-8%，在 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 上，比在相同提示下训练的已发布 DARTree 快 9-16%。

papers.title: BridgeKV: Large-Model Prefill and Small-Model Decoding for LLM Inference via KV Cache Translation
papers.summary: LLM inference has two phases with different bottlenecks: LLM prefill runs once per request and is compute-intensive. Decoding repeats for every output token and is limited by memory bandwidth. To address the challenges associated with this issue, different solutions have been proposed. All of these solutions use the same model for both prefill and decode phases. We propose BridgeKV, which uses a larger model for prefill and a smaller model of the same family for decoding. A lightweight KV-stitching module translates the larger model's prompt cache into the smaller model's cache layout. It handles differences in cache shape and representation through learned local layer mixing and separate nonlinear maps for keys and values. With both models frozen, we train the module to align their caches and make the smaller model follow the larger model's next-token predictions. A second training stage adds low-rank adapters when further task adaptation is needed. Across six model pairs and five datasets, BridgeKV outperforms fine-tuned small-model baselines with matched trainable parameter budgets in all 30 settings. It closes up to 80% of the quality gap to using the larger model for both phases. On one A40 GPU, Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B achieves 3.0X faster requests than the larger model alone, with latency close to the smaller model alone. BridgeKV can improve the hardware and system solutions that separate prefill and decode phases across GPUs. A separate serving simulation models request arrivals, queues, and cache transfer. For Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B to Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B, it predicts up to 33.86X faster requests and 27.5X lower energy use than using the larger model for both prefill and decode phases.

papers.title_zh: BridgeKV：通过 KV 缓存转换进行 LLM 推理的大模型预填充和小模型解码
papers.summary_zh: LLM 推理有两个具有不同瓶颈的阶段：LLM 预填充每个请求运行一次，并且是计算密集型的。每个输出令牌都会重复解码，并且受到内存带宽的限制。为了解决与此问题相关的挑战，已经提出了不同的解决方案。所有这些解决方案都在预填充和解码阶段使用相同的模型。我们提出了 BridgeKV，它使用较大的模型进行预填充，并使用同系列的较小模型进行解码。轻量级的 KV 拼接模块将较大模型的提示缓存转换为较小模型的缓存布局。它通过学习本地层混合以及键和值的单独非线性映射来处理缓存形状和表示的差异。在两个模型都冻结的情况下，我们训练模块来对齐它们的缓存，并使较小的模型遵循较大模型的下一个令牌预测。当需要进一步的任务适应时，第二个训练阶段会添加低等级适配器。在 6 个模型对和 5 个数据集上，BridgeKV 在所有 30 种设置中均优于微调的小模型基线，并具有匹配的可训练参数预算。与在两个阶段使用较大模型相比，它缩小了高达 80% 的质量差距。在一个 A40 GPU 上，Llama-3.1-Instruct-8B 到 Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B 的请求速度比单独的较大模型快 3.0 倍，延迟时间接近单独的较小模型。 BridgeKV 可以改进硬件和系统解决方案，将 GPU 上的预填充和解码阶段分开。单独的服务模拟模型请求到达、队列和缓存传输。对于 Llama-3.1-Instruct-70B 到 Llama-3.2-Instruct-1B，与在预填充和解码阶段使用较大模型相比，它预测请求速度提高了 33.86 倍，能耗降低了 27.5 倍。

papers.title: Semantically Aligned KV Cache Compression for Efficient Agentic Autoregressive Video Generation
papers.summary: Agentic autoregressive video generation combines semantic planning, sequential generation, and visual verification for controllable synthesis. Growing visual histories enlarge the key-value (KV) cache, increasing memory use and attention costs across candidate rollouts. Existing compression methods primarily optimize individual generators without the planner's semantic constraints, risking low priority for states supporting requested attributes or actions. We introduce SemanticKV, a training-free method for semantically aligned KV cache compression. To our knowledge, SemanticKV is the first KV cache compression method for agentic autoregressive video generation that explicitly uses planner-extracted semantic constraints to guide retention. Text cross-attention identifies constraint-related video positions, whose self-attention queries are collected into separate groups. Attention weights are averaged within each group and maximized across groups, giving each cached entry a high score when strongly used by any represented constraint. A single top-k selection retains high-scoring entries under the memory budget, leaving their keys, values, and positions unchanged. For fixed query groups and equal entry costs, this selection minimizes an additive upper bound on worst-group discarded attention. The method operates independently within each candidate without retraining or additional video generations. We evaluate four AR video backbones on three benchmarks for 5-, 30-, and 60-second generation. On Causal Forcing at a compression ratio of 0.7, SemanticKV obtains a VBench Total Score of 84.10, compared with 84.05 for the strongest compressed baseline and 83.99 for Full KV. It achieves a 1.22x speedup over Full KV and reduces KV-cache memory from 6.04 GB to 1.81 GB, a 3.35x reduction.

papers.title_zh: 语义对齐的 KV 缓存压缩可实现高效代理自回归视频生成
papers.summary_zh: 代理自回归视频生成结合了语义规划、顺序生成和视觉验证，以实现可控合成。不断增长的视觉历史记录扩大了键值 (KV) 缓存，从而增加了候选推出过程中的内存使用和注意力成本。现有的压缩方法主要在没有规划器语义约束的情况下优化单个生成器，从而存在支持请求的属性或操作的状态优先级较低的风险。我们介绍 SemanticKV，一种用于语义对齐 KV 缓存压缩的免训练方法。据我们所知，SemanticKV 是第一个用于代理自回归视频生成的 KV 缓存压缩方法，它明确使用规划器提取的语义约束来指导保留。文本交叉注意力识别与约束相关的视频位置，其自注意力查询被收集到单独的组中。注意力权重在每个组内进行平均，并在组之间最大化，从而在被任何表示的约束强烈使用时为每个缓存条目提供高分。单个 top-k 选择会在内存预算内保留高分条目，并保持其键、值和位置不变。对于固定查询组和相等的进入成本，此选择最小化了最差组丢弃注意力的附加上限。该方法在每个候选者中独立运行，无需重新训练或额外的视频生成。我们在 5 秒、30 秒和 60 秒一代的三个基准上评估了四种 AR 视频主干。在压缩比为 0.7 的因果强迫上，SemanticKV 的 VBench 总得分为 84.10，而最强压缩基线的得分为 84.05，Full KV 的得分为 83.99。与 Full KV 相比，它实现了 1.22 倍的加速，并将 KV 缓存内存从 6.04 GB 减少到 1.81 GB，减少了 3.35 倍。

papers.title: How Much Training-Inference Mismatch Can On-Policy Distillation Tolerate?
papers.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student language model on its own responses, guided by a fixed teacher. Generating these responses is expensive, so systems use quantized inference and asynchronous rollouts to reduce the cost. Both, however, introduce training-inference mismatch between the rollout engine and the model being trained. Such mismatch can destabilize reinforcement learning (RL), but its effects on OPD remain unclear. This paper investigates how much mismatch OPD tolerates, where its effects arise, and how training systems can use this tolerance. Measuring all mismatch sources on one scale, we examine quantization across three student-teacher pairs, with additional tests of weight staleness and injected noise on one pair. OPD tolerates substantial mismatch without meaningful loss of training quality but degrades at higher levels, revealing an empirical mismatch budget. Both the quality cost of mismatch and the mismatch introduced by quantization depend on the model, with some layers particularly sensitive to reduced precision. In controlled comparisons, OPD remains stable under rollout configurations that destabilize RL methods. Under weight noise, mismatch also shifts the prefixes reached during generation, introducing errors that per-token corrections cannot address. To put these findings into practice, we introduce a lightweight admission check that screens rollout configurations against a calibrated budget without requiring a full training run for each candidate. Model-specific FP8 recipes preserve training quality while providing capacity for at least $1.93\times$ as many KV-cache tokens as BF16. Combining FP8 with asynchronous rollouts reaches the same training quality $1.62\times$ sooner than synchronous BF16 training. Code is available at https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd

quality.verdict: 问题切中系统痛点，结论实用但外推仍有限。

papers.title_zh: 在策略蒸馏可以容忍多少训练-推理不匹配？
papers.summary_zh: 在政策蒸馏 (OPD) 在固定教师的指导下，根据学生自己的反应来训练学生语言模型。生成这些响应的成本很高，因此系统使用量化推理和异步推出来降低成本。然而，两者都会在推出引擎和正在训练的模型之间引入训练推理不匹配。这种不匹配会破坏强化学习 (RL) 的稳定性，但其对 OPD 的影响仍不清楚。本文研究了 OPD 能够容忍多少不匹配、其影响出现在哪里以及训练系统如何利用这种容忍度。在一个尺度上测量所有不匹配源，我们检查了三对学生-教师的量化，并对一对的权重陈旧性和注入噪声进行了额外的测试。 OPD 可以容忍严重的不匹配，而不会显着损失训练质量，但会在较高水平上降低，从而揭示了经验不匹配预算。不匹配的质量成本和量化引入的不匹配都取决于模型，某些层对精度降低特别敏感。在受控比较中，OPD 在破坏 RL 方法稳定性的推出配置下保持稳定。在权重噪声下，不匹配还会改变生成过程中达到的前缀，从而引入每个令牌校正无法解决的错误。为了将这些发现付诸实践，我们引入了一种轻量级准入检查，可以根据校准预算筛选部署配置，而无需为每个候选人进行完整的培训。特定于模型的 FP8 配方可保持训练质量，同时提供至少 1.93 美元\倍的 KV 缓存令牌容量（相当于 BF16）。将 FP8 与异步推出相结合，可以比同步 BF16 训练更快地达到相同的训练质量 $1.62\times$。代码可在 https://github.com/benyucong/train-inference-mismatch-opd 获取

papers.title: D3Tree: Learning to Prune Block-Diffusion Draft Trees for Efficient Verification
papers.summary: Block-diffusion drafters propose a whole block of tokens in one forward pass, and draft trees built from their position-wise marginals increase the expected accepted length of speculative decoding. Every tree node occupies a query row in target verification, so under concurrent serving low-yield branches compete with other requests for verification capacity. Existing tree methods select verified nodes by draft probability under a fixed or cost-selected per-request budget, and thus always retain a prefix of the drafter's ranking. We present D3Tree, which learns which nodes of a block-diffusion draft tree are worth verifying. A tree-size head with 2H+2 parameters predicts each candidate's conditional survival from the draft state, the candidate embedding, and its draft log-probability. Thresholding the product of these scores along parent chains yields an ancestor-closed subtree whose size adapts to each request and decoding round. The head is trained on a frozen drafter with conditional labels on the full candidate tree; an optional joint mode also steers the drafter toward the retained reference path. At serving time, D3Tree verifies whole trees under light load and, under heavy load, allocates one batch-wide node budget by predicted survival, sized to the target's matrix-multiplication tiles. Retained trees share one ancestor-masked target pass, while construction, pruning, and scheduling run on the GPU and overlap with the host. Across six vision-language verifiers and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, D3Tree is fastest in 70 of 72 load settings, with 3.2-4.0x speedup over autoregressive decoding for one request and 1.3-1.8x at 64 concurrent requests, where fixed-budget trees fall below autoregressive speed. Under a time-varying arrival trace, it has the lowest mean end-to-end latency in every arrival phase.

papers.title_zh: D3Tree：学习修剪块扩散草图树以进行高效验证
papers.summary_zh: 块扩散起草者在一次前向传递中提出一整块令牌，并且根据其位置边缘构建的草案树增加了推测解码的预期接受长度。每个树节点在目标验证中占用一个查询行，因此在并发服务下，低产分支会与其他请求竞争验证容量。现有的树方法在固定或按请求成本选择的预算下通过草案概率选择经过验证的节点，因此始终保留起草者排名的前缀。我们提出了 D3Tree，它可以学习块扩散草案树的哪些节点值得验证。具有 2H+2 个参数的树大小的头根据草稿状态、候选嵌入及其草稿对数概率来预测每个候选的条件生存。沿着父链对这些分数的乘积进行阈值化会产生一个祖先封闭子树，其大小适应每个请求和解码轮次。头部在冻结的绘图器上进行训练，在完整的候选树上带有条件标签；可选的联合模式还可引导制图员走向保留的参考路径。在服务时，D3Tree 会在轻负载下验证整棵树，并在重负载下根据预测的生存情况分配一批范围的节点预算，其大小适合目标的矩阵乘法图块。保留树共享一个祖先屏蔽的目标通道，而构造、修剪和调度在 GPU 上运行并与主机重叠。在 6 个视觉语言验证器以及 17 个文本和多模式基准测试中，D3Tree 在 72 种负载设置中的 70 种中是最快的，对于一个请求，比自回归解码加速 3.2-4.0 倍，在 64 个并发请求时加速 1.3-1.8 倍，其中固定预算树低于自回归速度。在时变到达轨迹下，它在每个到达阶段具有最低的平均端到端延迟。

papers.title: Verify Before You Fetch: Reliable KV Cache Compression for LLM Inference
papers.summary: Long-context applications, long-lived agents, and multi-agent systems require large language models (LLMs) to process and retain extensive information. In these settings, the KV cache can exceed GPU high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity, necessitating offloading to host memory, where CPU-to-GPU transfers can dominate inference latency. While KV cache compression can reduce data movement, query-agnostic compression that guarantees accurate attention for arbitrary queries is extremely challenging, if not impossible. We introduce VerKV, a hybrid approach that provides $(ε, δ)$ guarantees for approximating attention on any given query. VerKV maintains a compact set of query-agnostic pivotal tokens on the GPU, together with a token-level sketch of the full KV cache, while retaining the complete cache in CPU memory. We introduce a novel stochastic sampling procedure, PoissonComp, to select the pivotal tokens. At inference time, our proposed KVFetch algorithm uses the pivotal tokens and the sketch to estimate the relative error of the resulting attention computation. If the estimate satisfies a user-specified $(ε, δ)$ tolerance, inference proceeds without accessing host memory. Otherwise, VerKV performs query-aware retrieval to fetch additional tokens from the CPU, refining the attention computation to meet the required tolerance. Thus, VerKV enables attention with bounded approximation error while minimizing CPU-to-GPU transfers. We show that PoissonComp outperforms state-of-the-art approaches to KV cache compression. Combined with KVFetch, it achieves near-dense performance (90-100% of dense quality at 32K context length, averaged over RULER and LOFT), using Qwen3-4B, Qwen3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B, while reducing the GPU memory footprint by 8-32x and keeping CPU-to-GPU memory fetches within 2-23% of the cache per generated token, depending on the model.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方案有新意但证据仍偏摘要级。
pros: 提出“先验证后拉取”的混合机制，将误差保证与通信开销联动，思路新颖且实用。

papers.title_zh: 获取前验证：用于 LLM 推理的可靠 KV 缓存压缩
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文应用程序、长寿命代理和多代理系统需要大型语言模型 (LLM) 来处理和保留大量信息。在这些设置中，KV 缓存可能会超过 GPU 高带宽内存 (HBM) 容量，从而需要卸载到主机内存，其中 CPU 到 GPU 的传输可能会主导推理延迟。虽然 KV 缓存压缩可以减少数据移动，但保证对任意查询的准确关注的与查询无关的压缩即使不是不可能，也是极具挑战性的。我们引入 VerKV，一种混合​​方法，为任何给定查询的近似注意力提供 $(ε, δ)$ 保证。 VerKV 在 GPU 上维护一组紧凑的与查询无关的关键令牌，以及完整 KV 缓存的令牌级草图，同时在 CPU 内存中保留完整的缓存。我们引入了一种新颖的随机采样过程 PoissonComp 来选择关键标记。在推理时，我们提出的 KVFetch 算法使用关键标记和草图来估计最终注意力计算的相对误差。如果估计值满足用户指定的 $(ε, δ)$ 容差，则推理将继续进行，而无需访问主机内存。否则，VerKV 执行查询感知检索以从 CPU 获取额外的标记，从而改进注意力计算以满足所需的容差。因此，VerKV 能够实现有界近似误差的注意力，同时最大限度地减少 CPU 到 GPU 的传输。我们证明 PoissonComp 优于最先进的 KV 缓存压缩方法。与 KVFetch 相结合，它使用 Qwen3-4B、Qwen3.5-9B 和 Ministral-3-8B 实现近密集性能（在 32K 上下文长度下达到密集质量的 90-100%，在 RULER 和 LOFT 上平均），同时将 GPU 内存占用量减少 8-32 倍，并将 CPU 到 GPU 内存提取保持在每个生成令牌的缓存的 2-23% 范围内，具体取决于模型。

papers.title: Efficient VLA Inference via Retrieval-Based Speculation and Hardware Acceleration
papers.summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to understand and execute complex instructions, but their autoregressive (AR) action generation introduces significant latency on resource-constrained robotic platforms. Speculative decoding can accelerate AR-based inference by parallelizing action generation and verification; however, existing approaches rely on costly draft models, which are inefficient on edge platforms. In this paper, we propose Zora, a hardware-software co-design framework for accelerating AR-based VLA inference. Specifically, Zora introduces a lightweight retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-based draft model that exploits robotic dynamics without additional neural draft models. We further reduce batch verification overhead through a kinematics-guided action-acceptance strategy and a KV-cache-sharing attention mechanism. To address the retrieval overhead introduced by RAG-based drafting, we co-design dedicated hardware support, Zora core, to address the memory irregularity in RAG-based drafting. We evaluate Zora on four VLA models with the LIBERO benchmark. Zora retains comparable accuracy while achieving up to 3.4$\times$ speedup with software-only optimization and up to 7.6$\times$ speedup with hardware support over GPUs.
