papers.title_zh: HybridSpec：混合 GDN-MoE 模型的吞吐量感知推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 在推测性解码中，DFlash 等并行起草器使起草成本降低，因此目标验证在每一轮中占据主导地位。一个核心选​​择是验证长度，即目标在每轮中处理的令牌数量。验证更多的草稿令牌可以接受更多的草稿令牌，但第一次拒绝后的工作就被浪费了。对于结合了门控 DeltaNet (GDN) 和混合专家 (MoE) 层的混合目标模型，在这个长度下验证时间的增长速度比密集模型快得多。在带有 DFlash 的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的单请求配置文件中，它从长度 4 增长到 16，几乎完全在 GDN 和 MoE 层中增长了 71%，而密集的 Qwen3-4B 目标增长了 4%-6%。每个 GDN 层必须更新每个令牌的循环状态，并在接受的前缀末尾恢复它。 MoE 成本取决于代币激活的专家，只有在验证运行后才知道。我们提出了 HybridSpec，它根据草稿侧验收估计和测量的目标延迟来选择 GPU 上的验证长度。然后，在任何专家运行之前，验证会运行此长度加上一个额外的令牌，直到第一个 MoE 路由器。在那里，轻量级路由修正使用观察到的专家分配来决定是否保留该令牌。其余验证仅在选定的令牌上运行。块并行 GDN 内核避免在每个令牌之后存储状态，并在一次启动中重建每个 GDN 层的接受状态。在验证长度为 4 到 16 的独立基准测试中，每个草案令牌都被接受，这些内核（包括接受状态重建）比默认内核快 $1.54\times$-$4.04\times$。在单请求贪婪解码中使用三个 GDN-MoE 目标模型，HybridSpec 比自回归解码快 $1.75\times$-$1.88\times$，比 DFlash 快 $1.30\times$-$1.33\times$。

papers.title: Testing Processor Contracts in Speculative Decoding Engines
papers.summary: Speculative sampling can accelerate decoding without changing the target distribution. Its standard guarantee assumes that logits processors, which enforce constraints or modify token scores, receive the appropriate token prefix and state at each verification position. We formalize this processor-prefix contract and present BADC (branch-aware differential conformance testing). BADC combines enumerated references on tiny random models, checks of processor inputs and state, and simultaneous confidence bounds on output-event probabilities. Preregistered, source-informed experiments on selected Transformers and llama-cpp-python releases confirm two causes: processors read unverified drafts or advance state without rollback. For one pilot-selected prompt on a trained checkpoint, fresh samples give a 60.26-percentage-point lower bound on the difference in the probability of a predefined first-token event between ordinary and prompt-lookup decoding, with nominal simultaneous 95% coverage under within-arm i.i.d. sampling. Controlled comparisons establish no cause-recovery advantage of directed selection over random selection, while permutation testing detects each tested family at least as often as BADC. These findings connect processor-interface failures to observable decoding differences without establishing diagnostic superiority or workload prevalence.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，证据扎实但外推价值有限。
pros: 提出处理器-前缀契约并给出分支感知一致性测试框架，问题定义清晰
采用预注册与同时置信界等统计设计，能将接口失配与可观测分布差异建立联系
cons: 实验覆盖面与工作负载代表性不足，尚不能支持普遍影响规模判断
作者已承认在诊断优越性上无优势，方法相对现有检验的增量价值受限

papers.title_zh: 在推测解码引擎中测试处理器合约
papers.summary_zh: 推测采样可以在不改变目标分布的情况下加速解码。其标准保证假设强制约束或修改令牌分数的 logits 处理器在每个验证位置接收适当的令牌前缀和状态。我们正式确定了这个处理器前缀合同并提出了 BADC（分支感知差分一致性测试）。 BADC 结合了微小随机模型的枚举参考、处理器输入和状态的检查以及输出事件概率的同时置信界限。对选定的 Transformer 和 llama-cpp-python 版本进行的预注册、来源知情的实验证实了两个原因：处理器读取未经验证的草稿或提前状态而不回滚。对于训练检查点上的一个飞行员选择的提示，新样本给出了普通解码和提示查找解码之间预定义第一个令牌事件的概率差异的 60.26 个百分点的下限，在臂内 i.i.d 下标称同时覆盖率为 95%。采样。受控比较表明定向选择相对于随机选择没有原因恢复优势，而排列测试检测每个测试家族的频率至少与 BADC 一样。这些发现将处理器接口故障与可观察到的解码差异联系起来，但没有建立诊断优势或工作负载普遍性。

papers.title: ROCm InferaSim: Cut LLM Serving Trial Costs and Deploy the Best Configuration
papers.summary: Serving an LLM efficiently depends on the engine, how the model is split across GPUs, precision, scheduler settings, speculative decoding, KV-cache management, and prefill-decode disaggregation. The best configuration depends on the model, hardware, workload, and objective. Operators usually find it by trial and error. Exhaustively measuring the candidates in our study would take about 25,000 GPU-hours. ROCm InferaSim predicts serving performance from a few short measurements. Choices such as batch size, prompt length, and GPU count change the amount of work per GPU without changing the kernels. ROCm InferaSim benchmarks each distinct set of kernels once, on at most one node. We call this measurement an anchor. Analytical laws carry that anchor to other deployments that run the same kernels. For multi-node deployments, ROCm InferaSim reduces the configuration to a single-node equivalent, measures it, and scales the result analytically. A simulator replays multi-turn traffic, and a tuning agent searches configurations using the predictions. On AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs with vLLM, SGLang, and ATOM, 11 anchors took 9.1 GPU-hours, against 204 GPU-hours to measure the 226 fixed-length configurations they cover. On 172 configurations, time per output token has 8.1% median error. On a multi-turn coding workload, throughput is within 8%. For 159 disaggregated deployments, none used as an anchor, throughput is within 5.5%. A five-candidate short list contains a deployment within 12% of the best feasible pairing of model and latency target.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题重要、方法实用，但创新深度与验证边界一般。
pros: 直击LLM部署调参成本痛点，GPU小时节省量级有说服力
提出anchor+解析外推+流量回放调优的完整闭环，工程可落地性强
cons: 核心思想更偏系统建模与缩放工程整合，算法新颖性与跨平台泛化证据仍偏有限

papers.title_zh: ROCm InferaSim：降低 LLM 服务试用成本并部署最佳配置
papers.summary_zh: 有效地为 LLM 提供服务取决于引擎、模型如何在 GPU 之间分割、精度、调度程序设置、推测解码、KV 缓存管理和预填充解码分解。最佳配置取决于型号、硬件、工作负载和目标。操作员通常通过反复试验来找到它。彻底衡量我们研究中的候选者大约需要 25,000 个 GPU 小时。 ROCm InferaSim 通过一些简短的测量来预测服务性能。批处理大小、提示长度和 GPU 计数等选择会更改每个 GPU 的工作量，而无需更改内核。 ROCm InferaSim 最多在一个节点上对每组不同的内核进行一次基准测试。我们称这种测量为锚点。分析定律将该锚点应用于运行相同内核的其他部署。对于多节点部署，ROCm InferaSim 将配置减少为单节点等效配置，对其进行测量，并通过分析扩展结果。模拟器重播多轮流量，调整代理使用预测来搜索配置。在具有 vLLM、SGLang 和 ATOM 的 AMD Instinct MI355X GPU 上，11 个锚点需要 9.1 个 GPU 小时，而测量它们所覆盖的 226 个固定长度配置需要 204 个 GPU 小时。在 172 个配置中，每个输出令牌的时间中值误差为 8.1%。在多轮编码工作负载上，吞吐量在 8% 以内。对于 159 个分类部署（没有一个用作锚点），吞吐量在 5.5% 以内。五个候选者的短名单包含与模型和延迟目标的最佳可行配对相差 12% 以内的部署。

papers.title: FlagRot: Selective Rotation for Low-Bit KV Caches
papers.summary: Long-context inference is bound by the KV cache, which 2-bit codes could shrink about sixfold if their error stays in check. The usual remedy rotates keys before quantizing, assuming rotation always helps. However, we observe that it does not: rotation flattens a spiky piece of a key but can give a flat one a new peak, and both coexist within one key. We therefore propose FlagRot, which stores each 32-channel piece rotated or as is, whichever has the smaller calibrated attention error, and rotates the query instead when reading. We further show that how often to decide follows the quantization axis: per-channel caches such as KIVI need one decision per head, at no write cost, while per-token caches decide per key, with the choice stored in existing sign bits. At 2.5 bits per value, FlagRot lowers the twelve-model KL divergence of KIVI from 18.7 to 12.4 x 10^-3, below RotateKV on 9 of 12 models. Served as a vLLM plugin, it raises RULER at 128k tokens by +2.9 points and the LongBench v1 mean by +0.4 to +1.9 points on the three of four models where 2-bit KIVI loses accuracy. It also lowers the error of 4-bit integer and FP4 caches.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中要害，思路新颖实用，但证据仍需更全面。
pros: 抓住“旋转并非总收益”的关键反例，提出选择性旋转机制有新意
方法与量化轴对齐（per-head/per-key）并考虑工程落地，vLLM插件验证增强实用价值
cons: 摘要仅给出部分基线与模型覆盖，缺少开销、稳定性与极端场景的系统性消融
提升幅度在部分基准上偏中等，泛化到更多架构与更长上下文的说服力仍有限

papers.title_zh: FlagRot：低位 KV 缓存的选择性轮换
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文推理受到 KV 缓存的约束，如果错误得到控制，2 位代码可以缩小约六倍。通常的补救措施是在量化之前旋转关键点，假设旋转总是有帮助的。然而，我们观察到事实并非如此：旋转使键的尖峰部分变平，但可以给平的部分一个新的峰值，并且两者共存于一个键内。因此，我们提出 FlagRot，它存储每个旋转的 32 通道片段或按原样存储，以校准注意误差较小者为准，并在读取时旋转查询。我们进一步表明，决定的频率遵循量化轴：每通道缓存（例如 KIVI）需要每个头一个决定，而无需写入成本，而每令牌缓存决定每个键，并将选择存储在现有符号位中。在每个值 2.5 位的情况下，FlagRot 将 KIVI 的 12 个模型 KL 散度从 18.7 降低到 12.4 x 10^-3，在 12 个模型中的 9 个上低于 RotateKV。作为 vLLM 插件，它在 128k 代币的 RULER 上提高了 +2.9 点，在 2 位 KIVI 失去准确性的四个模型中的三个模型上，LongBench v1 平均值提高了 +0.4 到 +1.9 点。它还降低了 4 位整数和 FP4 缓存的错误。

papers.title: Ask, Don't Equip: Question-Driven Coding Agents for Deep Kernel Optimization
papers.summary: LLM agents for GPU kernel optimization sit at two ends of a structure-freedom tradeoff. Scripted agents fix what the model does at each step, via a learned policy, an optimization menu, or fixed roles, and are sample-efficient where the recipe applies and stall where it does not. Open-ended agents let a self-directed model mutate a population of kernels and pay for the freedom in trials: thousands of evaluations, repeated edits, and wrong candidates. Both respond to hard targets by equipping the agent with more: parsed profiler output, disassembly analysis, retrieval over documentation and libraries, and stores of lessons. We argue that both lack direction, a hypothesis about where the remaining gap is, and that a short question asked at the right moment supplies it without narrowing what the agent may do next. We present KernelSeek, a question-driven agent that makes an existing CUDA kernel faster with no operator-specific knowledge and no faster implementation to imitate: a general-purpose coding agent, a minimal harness that enforces a verifiable goal, and questions at decision points, first from a human, then from a bank the agent applies to itself. On the same task, evaluator, hardware, and week, a tool-rich autonomous agent built in the prevailing style plateaued at 0.50x FlashAttention-3 after 133 model-driven steps; KernelSeek reached 1.13x. It then produced dependency-free FlashAttention forward kernels for Hopper and Blackwell, single CUDA files with no CUTLASS, CuTe, cuBLAS, or cuDNN, correct on all 182 scenarios per architecture and 1.16x FlashAttention-3 and 1.46x FlashAttention-4 (geometric mean). Across 162 human messages and 11.5K agent tool calls, every large gain followed a question that moved the agent to a different layer of the system or rejected a claimed limit, never one that supplied information. We release the kernels, harness, question bank, and all traces.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路新颖且结果亮眼，但证据链仍偏单薄。
pros: 提出“问题驱动”代理范式，较好切中现有脚本化与开放式方法的方向性缺口
在高价值GPU内核优化任务上报告了显著速度收益，并承诺公开轨迹与工件
cons: 实验覆盖面窄，核心结论主要来自单一任务与有限对照，外部可推广性不足

papers.title_zh: 询问，不要装备：用于深度内核优化的问题驱动编码代理
papers.summary_zh: 用于 GPU 内核优化的 LLM 代理位于结构自由权衡的两端。脚本化代理通过学习策略、优化菜单或固定角色来修复模型在每个步骤中执行的操作，并且在适用配方的地方具有样本效率，在不适用配方的地方则停滞不前。开放式智能体让自我导向的模型改变一群内核，并为试验中的自由付出代价：数千次评估、重复编辑和错误的候选者。两者都通过为代理配备更多功能来响应硬目标：解析分析器输出、反汇编分析、文档和库检索以及课程存储。我们认为两者都缺乏方向，即对剩余差距在哪里的假设，并且在正确的时刻提出一个简短的问题可以提供方向，而不会缩小智能体下一步可能做什么。我们提出了 KernelSeek，一个问题驱动的代理，它使现有的 CUDA 内核更快，无需特定于操作员的知识，也无需模仿更快的实现：通用编码代理，强制执行可验证目标的最小工具，以及决策点的问题，首先来自人类，然后来自代理应用于自身的银行。在相同的任务、评估器、硬件和周内，以流行风格构建的工具丰富的自主代理在 133 个模型驱动步骤后稳定在 0.50x FlashAttention-3； KernelSeek 达到 1.13 倍。然后，它为 Hopper 和 Blackwell 生成了无依赖性的 FlashAttention 前向内核、没有 CUTLASS、CuTe、cuBLAS 或 cuDNN 的单个 CUDA 文件，在每个架构的所有 182 个场景上都正确，并且是 1.16 倍的 FlashAttention-3 和 1.46 倍的 FlashAttention-4（几何平均值）。在 162 条人工消息和 11,500 次代理工具调用中，每一次重大收获都伴随着一个问题，该问题将代理移至系统的不同层或拒绝声称的限制，但从未提供信息。我们发布了内核、工具、问题库和所有痕迹。

papers.title: Multi-layer Indexer: Overlapping Selection and Attention in DeepSeek Sparse Attention
papers.summary: Sparse attention cuts the cost of long-context inference by making the attention matrix sparse: each query attends only a subset of the sequence, chosen by a fixed pattern or, in recent production LLMs, learned per query. In DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), the attention of DeepSeek-V3.2 and the GLM-5 family, every layer is preceded by a lightning indexer that scores the whole cache and keeps the k=2048 highest-scoring tokens for the layer to attend. At long context this indexer scan, not the sparse attention it feeds, is where the decode time goes. But adjacent layers select nearly the same tokens, so a layer can attend the selection of the previous indexer layer instead of its own. This removes the dependency: each indexer then runs concurrently with the attention of its layer. The resulting Multi-layer Indexer (MLI) needs no retraining and no new weights. Its default realization changes no kernel, running inside SGLang's production decode graph; an optional fused decode kernel accelerates it further on DeepSeek-V3.2. MLI composes with IndexCache (the cross-layer reuse GLM-5.2 ships as IndexShare): IndexCache drops the indexer from some layers, and MLI hides the scan on the rest. We serve DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5 under IndexCache's protocol at retentions 1/2 to 1/32 (the fraction of layers that keep an indexer) and contexts 10K to 195K. At equal retention the composition decodes faster than IndexCache: up to 14.5% faster on DeepSeek-V3.2 and 9.8% on GLM-5 at 1/2, and 7.9% and 5.1% at 1/4, largest where IndexCache keeps the most indexers and growing with context. At retention 1/r it is faster still than IndexCache at 1/(2r) while keeping twice the fresh selections: at 128K it reaches 1.32x the unmodified model's decode throughput at 1/4, above IndexCache's 1.28x at 1/8. Its LongBench, RULER and LongBench v2 accuracy stays within a few percentage points of IndexCache's.
papers.comment: 20 pages (8 pages main text), 4 figures, 11 tables. Accepted to the Long-Context Foundation Models (LCFM) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026, Atlanta, December 12, 2026. Code: https://github.com/ArjunKrishnak/dsa-multi-layer-indexer

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但证据链仍偏系统优化层面。
pros: 抓住DSA解码瓶颈并用跨层重叠并行化，思路实用且可部署
无需重训和默认不改内核，且与IndexCache可组合，收益在长上下文明确

papers.title_zh: 多层索引器：DeepSeek稀疏注意力中的重叠选择和注意力
papers.summary_zh: 稀疏注意力通过使注意力矩阵稀疏来降低长上下文推理的成本：每个查询仅关注序列的一个子集，由固定模式选择，或者在最近的生产法学硕士中，每个查询都学习。在 DeepSeek 稀疏注意力 (DSA)、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5 系列的注意力中，每一层之前都有一个闪电索引器，该索引器对整个缓存进行评分，并保留 k=2048 个最高得分令牌供该层参与。在长上下文中，解码时间花在索引器扫描上，而不是它所提供的稀疏注意力上。但相邻层选择几乎相同的标记，因此层可以参与前一个索引器层的选择，而不是自己的选择。这消除了依赖性：每个索引器然后与其层的注意力同时运行。由此产生的多层索引器 (MLI) 不需要重新训练，也不需要新的权重。它的默认实现不改变内核，在 SGLang 的生产解码图中运行；可选的融合解码内核可在 DeepSeek-V3.2 上进一步加速。 MLI 与 IndexCache 组合（跨层重用 GLM-5.2 作为 IndexShare 提供）：IndexCache 从某些层删除索引器，MLI 隐藏其余层的扫描。我们在 IndexCache 协议下提供 DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GLM-5，保留量为 1/2 到 1/32（保留索引器的层的分数），上下文为 10K 到 195K。在保留相同的情况下，该组合的解码速度比 IndexCache 更快：在 1/2 时，DeepSeek-V3.2 上快了 14.5%，在 GLM-5 上快了 9.8%，在 1/4 时分别快了 7.9% 和 5.1%，其中 IndexCache 保留了最多的索引器，并随着上下文而增长。在保留 1/r 时，它仍然比 IndexCache 在 1/(2r) 时更快，同时保留两倍的新鲜选择：在 128K 时，它达到未修改模型解码吞吐量的 1.32 倍（1/4 时），高于 IndexCache 1/8 时的 1.28 倍。它的 LongBench、RULER 和 LongBench v2 准确度与 IndexCache 的准确度相差几个百分点。

papers.title: Introducing Cluster Efficiency to LLM Serving: Pooling Economical Accelerators over Fast Interconnects
papers.summary: Long-context large language model (LLM) serving places substantial demands on compute, memory capacity, and memory bandwidth. Economical accelerators can offer these resources at lower cost, but their limited per-device capacity requires pooling across devices, making communication overhead critical. We study cluster efficiency, measured in tokens per dollar and per joule, and show how low-latency, high-bandwidth interconnects enable economical accelerators to retain their cost advantage. Guided by a characterization of coding-agent workloads and accelerator scaling, we realize this design on the Tenstorrent Galaxy, a cluster of Blackhole chips. The serving stack combines integrated communication engines, pipelined ring transfers, communication-computation overlap, and device-side decode replay to reduce collective overhead. Across three dense models in BF16 and 8-bit configurations with 8K-256K-token contexts, the Galaxy achieves 1.07-2.24$\times$ the tokens per dollar of an eight-GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell server under a three-year acquisition-and-electricity cost model. Emulating TCP-class communication on the same chips reduces throughput by 23.5-67.4% and eliminates the cost advantage in every evaluated configuration. These results demonstrate how fast interconnects translate the per-dollar resource advantages of economical accelerators into cost-efficient long-context LLM serving.

quality.verdict: 选题重要且工程扎实，但证据外推性仍有限。

papers.title_zh: 将集群效率引入 LLM 服务：通过快速互连汇集经济型加速器
papers.summary_zh: 长上下文大语言模型 (LLM) 服务对计算、内存容量和内存带宽提出了很高的要求。经济型加速器可以以较低的成本提供这些资源，但其每台设备的容量有限，需要跨设备进行池化，这使得通信开销变得至关重要。我们研究以每美元和每焦耳的代币衡量的集群效率，并展示低延迟、高带宽互连如何使经济型加速器保持其成本优势。在编码代理工作负载和加速器扩展特性的指导下，我们在 Tenstorrent Galaxy（黑洞芯片集群）上实现了这一设计。服务堆栈结合了集成通信引擎、流水线环传输、通信计算重叠和设备端解码重放，以减少集体开销。在具有 8K-256K 代币环境的 BF16 和 8 位配置的三种密集模型中，在三年购置和电力成本模型下，Galaxy 实现了 8 GPU RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 服务器每美元 1.07-2.24$\times$ 的代币成本。在相同芯片上模拟 TCP 级通信可将吞吐量降低 23.5-67.4%，并消除每个评估配置的成本优势。这些结果表明，快速互连如何将经济型加速器的单位美元资源优势转化为经济高效的长上下文法学硕士服务。

papers.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding (SD) accelerates large language model inference by reducing the sequential cost of token-by-token generation. Advanced SD methods reduce proposal cost with parallel drafters that predict entire blocks in one forward pass, but overall speedup still depends on acceptance length. On-policy distillation (OPD) can push well-trained drafters beyond acceptance-length plateaus, yet conventional pipelines collect supervision through sequential draft-and-verify rollouts. Our key insight is that on-policy supervision need not inherit these dependencies: a draft block can be supervised using only its reference prefix and draft-sampled history. We propose SpecOPD, a branch-parallel OPD framework that parallelizes draft sampling and target supervision across independent branches drawn from the evolving drafter policy at reference anchors. We pack these branches into proposal trees to share target-prefix computation, using tree masks for full attention, branch-consistent indexer groups for sparse attention, and indexed state replay for linear attention to preserve each branch's history. We train the drafter with an E2E-TV surrogate that directly targets acceptance length. Our study spans 8B full-attention (GQA), 27B full-linear (GQA--GDN), and 125B sparse-linear (QSA--GDN) targets, three parallel draft architectures (DFlash, DSpark, and DFlash V2), and four task domains (dialogue, coding, mathematics, and agentic). SpecOPD achieves up to 41.45% higher mean acceptance length, $16.09\times$ supervised-token throughput over sequential-rollout OPD under native configurations, and up to $3.56\times$ generation speedup over autoregressive decoding.

cons: 摘要缺少关键训练/评测细节与统计显著性信息，严谨性判断受限
速度收益与接受长度提升可能依赖特定系统与配置，泛化风险未充分说明

papers.title_zh: SpecOPD：用于推测解码的分支并行同策略蒸馏
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码 (SD) 通过减少逐个令牌生成的顺序成本来加速大型语言模型推理。先进的 SD 方法通过并行绘图器在一次前向传递中预测整个块来降低提案成本，但总体加速仍然取决于接受长度。按政策蒸馏 (OPD) 可以推动训练有素的起草人员超越验收长度平台，而传统管道通过顺序起草和验证推出来收集监督。我们的主要见解是，在策略监督不需要继承这些依赖关系：可以仅使用其参考前缀和草稿采样历史记录来监督草稿块。我们提出了 SpecOPD，这是一个分支并行的 OPD 框架，它可以并行地跨独立分支进行草稿采样和目标监督，这些独立分支是从参考锚点不断发展的起草者策略中得出的。我们将这些分支打包到提议树中以共享目标前缀计算，使用树掩码进行充分注意，使用分支一致的索引器组进行稀疏注意，并使用索引状态重放进行线性注意以保留每个分支的历史记录。我们使用直接针对接受长度的 E2E-TV 代理来培训起草者。我们的研究涵盖 8B 全注意力 (GQA)、27B 全线性 (GQA--GDN) 和 125B 稀疏线性 (QSA--GDN) 目标、三个并行草案架构（DFlash、DSpark 和 DFlash V2）以及四个任务域（对话、编码、数学和代理）。与本机配置下的顺序推出 OPD 相比，SpecOPD 的平均接受长度提高了 41.45%，监督令牌吞吐量提高了 16.09 美元倍，生成速度比自回归解码提高了 3.56 倍。

papers.title: PGuard: A Native, Streaming, and Plug-in Guardrail for Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.summary: As streaming generation becomes the dominant serving paradigm for both text-only and multimodal large language models, ensuring safety throughout the generation process has become a critical challenge. We introduce PGuard, a native, streaming, and plug-in guardrail that transforms safety monitoring from an external serving dependency into an integrated capability of the backbone model. PGuard directly leverages the backbone's intermediate representations for token-level safety detection, without altering its original inference pathway or generation behavior. Specifically, dynamic layer gating selectively aggregates residual-stream representations across layers to extract safety-relevant signals during both prefill and autoregressive decoding. To balance detection accuracy and computational efficiency, PGuard supports multiple representation-modeling architectures, including a lightweight stateless variant and sequence-aware variants built on multi-scale causal EMA-attention and GRU-based recurrent modules. Its design also accounts for the execution characteristics of LLM serving frameworks, such as SGLang, optimizing computation and data access to minimize additional runtime and synchronization overhead. As a result, PGuard incurs only 0.82-2.26% end-to-end overhead on the hundred-billion-parameter backbone Qwen3.5-122B-A10B served by SGLang. Extensive evaluations across more than 30 benchmarks spanning text and multimodal safety, jailbreaks, cyber and CBRN risks, multilingual scenarios, and real-world traffic demonstrate state-of-the-art performance among native guardrails. On text queries with Qwen3.5-9B, PGuard achieves an average F1 score of 0.836, approaching dedicated external guardrails, while supporting deployment-time configuration of category-specific thresholds and enforcement actions.

quality.verdict: 工程价值高，但学术证据仍需更扎实。
pros: 将流式安全检测原生化到骨干模型，契合实际推理部署需求
在超大模型与SGLang上报告低开销并覆盖多场景评测，实用性强
cons: 摘要缺少关键消融与统计显著性信息，SOTA结论与泛化稳健性仍有不确定性

papers.title_zh: PGuard：用于多模式大型语言模型的本机、流式传输和插件护栏
papers.summary_zh: 随着流式生成成为纯文本和多模式大语言模型的主要服务范例，确保整个生成过程的安全性已成为一项关键挑战。我们引入了 PGuard，这是一种原生的、流式的、插件式的护栏，它将安全监控从外部服务依赖转变为骨干模型的集成功能。 PGuard 直接利用主干的中间表示进行令牌级安全检测，而不改变其原始推理路径或生成行为。具体来说，动态层选通有选择地聚合跨层的残余流表示，以在预填充和自回归解码期间提取与安全相关的信号。为了平衡检测精度和计算效率，PGuard 支持多种表示建模架构，包括基于多尺度因果 EMA-attention 和基于 GRU 的循环模块构建的轻量级无状态变体和序列感知变体。其设计还考虑了 LLM 服务框架（例如 SGLang）的执行特性，优化计算和数据访问以最大限度地减少额外的运行时和同步开销。因此，PGuard 在 SGLang 服务的千亿参数主干 Qwen3.5-122B-A10B 上仅产生 0.82-2.26% 的端到端开销。对 30 多个基准的广泛评估涵盖文本和多模式安全、越狱、网络和 CBRN 风险、多语言场景和现实世界交通，展示了本机护栏中最先进的性能。在使用 Qwen3.5-9B 进行文本查询时，PGuard 的平均 F1 分数为 0.836，接近专用外部护栏，同时支持特定类别阈值和强制操作的部署时配置。

papers.title: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative decoding is deployment-specific, and no universal optimization fits every serving regime, drafter, target model and GPU. To address these challenges, we present SpecPilot, an autonomous agentic loop that discovers algorithms and systems optimizations for each deployment. In each round, a cost model locates the largest gaps between the current system and its ceiling. Parallel agents explore directions and integrate the successful ones. Token forcing checks every output token against stock to detect reward hacking. A structured memory carries validated mechanisms to new rounds and deployments. SpecPilot discovered a general lossless 12-bit weight format, tree verification for hybrid recurrent targets, two-level verification and three batching mechanisms. We evaluate it across four target models, three drafters, two GPU platforms and five benchmarks. Without training or quality loss, it raises the speedup over AR from stock's 4.46$\times$ to 10.87$\times$ with one request, and from 1.94$\times$ to 3.93$\times$ with batching.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题重要、结果亮眼，但严谨性仍待实证加固。
pros: 面向真实部署痛点提出“算法+系统”联合自动发现框架，定位准确
跨模型/草稿器/GPU与多基准报告大幅加速，且宣称无训练与无质量损失

papers.title_zh: SpecPilot：推测解码的自主算法发现和系统优化
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过轻量级起草器加速内存限制的 LLM 解码，而并行起草器通过在一次前向传递中起草整个块来扩展这种加速。然而，目前尚不清楚他们发布的系统（库存）是否达到了并行起草允许的全部加速。我们确定了三个挑战。首先，通过一个请求，每个步骤接受很少的令牌，但读取每个目标权重。其次，通过批处理，每个请求的验证工作比自回归 (AR) 解码的速度大约减半。第三，推测性解码是特定于部署的，并且没有适合每个服务机制、起草者、目标模型和 GPU 的通用优化。为了应对这些挑战，我们推出了 SpecPilot，这是一个自主代理循环，可以发现每个部署的算法和系统优化。在每一轮中，成本模型都会找出当前系统与其上限之间的最大差距。并行代理探索方向并整合成功的方向。代币强制根据库存检查每个输出代币，以检测奖励黑客行为。结构化内存将经过验证的机制带到新的回合和部署中。 SpecPilot 发现了通用的无损 12 位权重格式、混合循环目标的树验证、两级验证和三种批处理机制。我们通过四个目标模型、三个绘图器、两个 GPU 平台和五个基准对其进行评估。在没有训练或质量损失的情况下，它通过一个请求将 AR 的加速比从库存的 4.46$\times$ 提高到 10.87$\times$，通过批处理从 1.94$\times$ 提高到 3.93$\times$。

papers.title: Turbo-GMM: FlashAttention-Inspired GPU-Accelerated Gaussian Mixture Model
papers.summary: Expectation-maximization (EM) for Gaussian mixture models (GMMs) requires scoring $N$ data points against $K$ mixture components. Prior fused GPU implementations, notably Flash-GMM, eliminate materialization of the $N \times K$ responsibility matrix but traverse the component dimension twice to compute normalization terms and accumulate sufficient statistics. We introduce Turbo-GMM, a single-sweep fused EM kernel that completes responsibility normalization and sufficient-statistic accumulation within one traversal of the component dimension. By retaining the complete component axis on chip, Turbo-GMM avoids the second score computation required by the released two-sweep Flash-GMM implementation. Its applicability is limited by register pressure, occupancy, and the component and feature dimensions, making it particularly suitable for large datasets with relatively small numbers of components. For larger configurations, Turbo-GMM employs a two-pass fallback following the established fused design. We establish algebraic equivalence to standard EM in real arithmetic and evaluate sixteen configurations on an NVIDIA A100. Under the reported benchmarking protocol, Turbo-GMM achieves a median $2.15\times$ speedup over the evaluated Flash-GMM implementation and up to $5.3\times$ and $9.9\times$ over PyTorch and \texttt{scikit-learn}, respectively. The results demonstrate the potential of single-sweep component traversal while identifying on-chip resource constraints as the principal limitation of this approach.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程优化扎实，但通用性与证据深度不足。
pros: 抓住两次遍历瓶颈，提出单次遍历融合EM内核思路清晰
在A100多配置给出可观加速，中位2.15倍结果有实用价值
cons: 方法受寄存器与占用率限制明显，适用范围偏窄
对比主要基于已发布实现，缺少跨硬件与端到端训练场景验证

papers.title_zh: Turbo-GMM：受 FlashAttention 启发的 GPU 加速高斯混合模型
papers.summary_zh: 高斯混合模型 (GMM) 的期望最大化 (EM) 需要针对 $K$ 混合分量对 $N$ 数据点进行评分。 Prior fused GPU implementations, notably Flash-GMM, eliminate materialization of the $N \times K$ responsibility matrix but traverse the component dimension twice to compute normalization terms and accumulate sufficient statistics. We introduce Turbo-GMM, a single-sweep fused EM kernel that completes responsibility normalization and sufficient-statistic accumulation within one traversal of the component dimension. By retaining the complete component axis on chip, Turbo-GMM avoids the second score computation required by the released two-sweep Flash-GMM implementation. Its applicability is limited by register pressure, occupancy, and the component and feature dimensions, making it particularly suitable for large datasets with relatively small numbers of components.对于较大的配置，Turbo-GMM 采用遵循既定融合设计的两遍回退。我们在实际算术中建立了与标准 EM 的代数等价性，并在 NVIDIA A100 上评估了 16 种配置。 Under the reported benchmarking protocol, Turbo-GMM achieves a median $2.15\times$ speedup over the evaluated Flash-GMM implementation and up to $5.3\times$ and $9.9\times$ over PyTorch and \texttt{scikit-learn}, respectively. The results demonstrate the potential of single-sweep component traversal while identifying on-chip resource constraints as the principal limitation of this approach.

papers.title: EviCast: Forecasting Retrieval Gains Through Shared Response Calibration
papers.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) extends large language models with external evidence, yet relevant evidence does not ensure that a generator can use it. Indiscriminate retrieval can degrade task performance while adding retrieval and long-context inference costs. Existing methods neither determine before large-scale execution whether a generator, task distribution, and retriever configuration is worth deploying nor diagnose multiple candidate retrievers under a shared budget. We introduce EviCast, a framework that forecasts retrieval value through interventional evidence-state decomposition. EviCast measures a generator's response to controlled evidence states once and combines this shared profile with the offline evidence-state distribution of each candidate retriever, yielding the end-to-end net utility and its 95% lower confidence bound without executing every RAG configuration. A state-refinement analysis characterizes when its binary and topology-aware instantiations are exact and when shared calibration is statistically more efficient than per-retriever calibration. In frozen evaluations, EviCast correctly decides all 14 HotpotQA retrieval configurations with a forecast error of 2.75 F1 points while reducing diagnostic generation calls by 80%, and it attains the lowest forecast error among seven predictors in the low-budget regime. Its topology-aware instantiation, EviCast-T, captures the complementarity between terminal and bridge evidence, correctly deciding all 16 configurations on MuSiQue and HotpotQA and 23 of 24 after prospective transfer to a third dataset. These results show that retrieval deployment depends on both evidence availability and the generator's ability to convert evidence structure into stable net utility. Code is available at https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法实用但外推证据仍偏有限。
pros: 提出共享校准+证据状态分解，能在部署前预测RAG净收益并给出置信下界

papers.title_zh: EviCast：通过共享响应校准预测检索增益
papers.summary_zh: 检索增强生成（RAG）利用外部证据扩展了大型语言模型，但相关证据并不能确保生成器可以使用它。不加区别的检索会降低任务性能，同时增加检索和长上下文推理成本。现有方法既不能在大规模执行之前确定生成器、任务分配和检索器配置是否值得部署，也不能在共享预算下诊断多个候选检索器。我们引入了 EviCast，一个通过介入性证据状态分解来预测检索价值的框架。 EviCast 测量生成器对受控证据状态的响应一次，并将此共享配置文件与每个候选检索器的离线证据状态分布相结合，产生端到端网络效用及其 95% 的置信下限，而无需执行每个 RAG 配置。状态细化分析的特征是其二进制和拓扑感知实例何时准确，以及共享校准在统计上比每个检索器校准更有效。在冻结评估中，EviCast 正确决定了所有 14 个 HotpotQA 检索配置，预测误差为 2.75 F1 点，同时将诊断生成调用减少了 80%，并且在低预算制度下的七个预测器中实现了最低的预测误差。其拓扑感知实例化 EviCast-T 捕获了终端和桥证据之间的互补性，正确判定 MuSiQue 和 HotpotQA 上的所有 16 个配置，以及在预期传输到第三个数据集后的 24 个配置中的 23 个。这些结果表明，检索部署取决于证据可用性和生成器将证据结构转换为稳定净效用的能力。代码可在 https://github.com/YiboWang2002/EviCast 获取。

papers.title: FactorSpec: Serving Exact Relational Constraints as Speculative Drafts
papers.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM serving by drafting tokens that the target model verifies in one pass, and its gain grows with the drafts the target accepts. Structured outputs should be an ideal case, because much of a record follows from relations among its fields: an itinerary's days follow from its cities' stays and flights. Serving engines, however, draft such text by proposing it from the prompt or a learned head, and their grammar masks enforce only syntax, so the model must satisfy the relations, which it violates: on NATURAL PLAN's trip problems, Qwen3-8B writes a valid itinerary for 10%, and retries that name the violated relation raise this to 14%. We present FactorSpec, which serves exact relational constraints as speculative drafts. FactorSpec compiles a JSON Schema and its relations into a factor graph with an exact feasibility check, drafts every token the constraint determines as certain, verifies each request at a width chosen for it, and computes the masks in worker processes outside the scheduler while the GPU runs. In SGLang, its drafts yield up to 10.5 tokens per verify step, up to 1.9x those of the fastest n-gram drafter, and it decodes up to 1.43x faster than speculators tuned per load, at a grammar mask's cost; it also leads in vLLM. Because every record is also valid, it serves up to 13.9x the valid records per GPU-second of syntax-only baselines.

papers.title_zh: FactorSpec：作为推测草案提供精确的关系约束
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码通过起草目标模型一次性验证的令牌来加速 LLM 服务，并且其增益随着目标接受的草案而增长。结构化输出应该是一个理想的情况，因为大部分记录都来自其领域之间的关系：行程的天数取决于其城市的停留和航班。然而，服务引擎通过从提示或学习头中提议来起草此类文本，并且它们的语法掩码仅强制执行语法，因此模型必须满足它所违反的关系：在 NATURAL PLAN 的行程问题上，Qwen3-8B 编写了 10% 的有效行程，并重试命名违反的关系，将其提高到 14%。我们提出 FactorSpec，它作为投机草案提供精确的关系约束。 FactorSpec 通过精确的可行性检查将 JSON 模式及其关系编译成因子图，起草约束确定为确定的每个标记，以为其选择的宽度验证每个请求，并在 GPU 运行时计算调度程序外部工作进程中的掩码。在 SGLang 中，其草稿每个验证步骤最多可产生 10.5 个令牌，是最快的 n-gram 草稿器的 1.9 倍，并且其解码速度比每次加载调整的投机器快 1.43 倍，而代价是语法掩码；它在 vLLM 领域也处于领先地位。由于每条记录也是有效的，因此每 GPU 秒提供的有效记录数是纯语法基线的 13.9 倍。

papers.title: LARK: Lean-Assisted Reasoning for LLM-Generated GPU Kernels
papers.summary: Efficient GPU kernels are typically low-level and hardware-specific, and LLM agents can now generate them faster than experts can verify. Existing approaches rely on testing, which provides evidence but not a guarantee of correctness. We introduce LARK, an agentic framework that automatically and formally verifies GPU kernels against their PyTorch reference implementations. LARK proves equivalence in functional and memory behavior under exact arithmetic and establishes a new trust boundary: human effort is only needed to verify operator-level Lean semantics ahead of kernel generation time, instead of checking every single line of generated code. LARK formalizes the GPU machine model and the semantics of each operation in Lean 4 once per target language, and the Lean 4 semantics of any incoming kernel is derived from these pre-built definitions. LLM agents then automate the proof in two steps. First, an agent decomposes the whole kernel semantics into smaller segments and Lean 4 verifies this segmentation, which addresses the intractability of proving equivalence for large kernels directly. Second, agents write Lean proofs that each kernel segment matches its high-level PyTorch counterpart. Together, the two steps give whole-program equivalence. We demonstrate that LARK can be used 1) to ensure correctness in existing code-generation agents and 2) to automatically verify human-written kernel libraries. On the KernelCraft GPU tasks, combined with a simple ReAct agent, LARK enables GLM 5.3 to fully verify 10 of 12 Level-1 kernels and Opus 5.5 all 5 Level-2 kernels. Moreover, over 10 production kernels randomly sampled from popular open-source LLM serving frameworks, LARK verifies 9 and identifies a new data race bug in the tenth. We believe LARK represents a significant step toward verifiable code generation in the agentic era.

quality.verdict: 方向新颖且潜力大，但可信度仍依赖补充细节。

“一次性语义建模”与人工验证成本可能较高，跨后端迁移成本和维护负担尚不清晰

papers.title_zh: LARK：LLM 生成的 GPU 内核的精益辅助推理
papers.summary_zh: 高效的 GPU 内核通常是低级且特定于硬件的，LLM 代理现在可以比专家验证的速度更快地生成它们。现有的方法依赖于测试，测试提供了证据，但不能保证正确性。我们引入 LARK，这是一个代理框架，可以根据 PyTorch 参考实现自动正式验证 GPU 内核。 LARK 证明了精确算术下功能和内存行为的等效性，并建立了新的信任边界：只需在内核生成时间之前验证操作员级精益语义，而不需要检查生成的每一行代码。 LARK 将 GPU 机器模型和 Lean 4 中每个操作的语义形式化为每种目标语言一次，任何传入内核的 Lean 4 语义都源自这些预构建的定义。然后，LLM 代理分两步自动完成证明。首先，代理将整个内核语义分解为更小的片段，Lean 4 验证此分段，这解决了直接证明大内核等效性的棘手问题。其次，代理编写精益证明，证明每个内核段与其高级 PyTorch 对应部分相匹配。这两个步骤一起提供了整个程序的等效性。我们证明 LARK 可用于 1) 确保现有代码生成代理的正确性，2) 自动验证人工编写的内核库。在 KernelCraft GPU 任务上，结合简单的 ReAct 代理，LARK 使 GLM 5.3 能够完全验证 12 个 Level-1 内核中的 10 个，以及 Opus 5.5 完全验证所有 5 个 Level-2 内核。此外，从流行的开源 LLM 服务框架中随机抽取的 10 多个生产内核，LARK 验证了 9 个，并在第 10 个中识别出新的数据竞争错误。我们相信 LARK 代表了代理时代向可验证代码生成迈出的重要一步。

papers.title: EarlySelectKV: Anticipatory KV Selection via Cross-Layer Query Proxies
papers.summary: Query-conditioned sparse KV selection reduces long-context inference cost by attending to a subset of historical KV entries at each decoding step. Existing selectors must wait for the target-layer query before scoring candidates and generating indices, placing routing on the immediate pre-attention path. We introduce EarlySelectKV, a training-free transformation that uses proxy queries from earlier hidden states to precompute selected KV indices while retaining the real target-layer query for final attention. Tests with RocketKV, Quest, and Loki show no consistent pattern of quality degradation across the evaluated settings. In the primary RocketKV evaluation, ES-RocketKV differs by +0.018 points on LongBench, approximately -0.01 points on RULER, and +0.25 percentage points on representative NIAH/Passkey settings. In a TensorRT-LLM deployment with CPU-offloaded routing, ES-RocketKV improves end-to-end output throughput by up to 12.4% and reduces GPU-resident memory by 11.1% of the combined KV/K-summary pool. This makes routing timing an explicit optimization target alongside KV subset selection in sparse long-context decoding. Code is available at https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV.
papers.journal_ref: Proceedings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing, pp. 5272-5291 (2026)

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 工程价值明确，但学术说服力仍偏弱
pros: 将KV路由从目标层查询依赖中前移，聚焦了长期被忽视的关键路径时序优化
在TensorRT-LLM与CPU offload场景报告了可感知的端到端吞吐和显存收益，且质量基本持平
cons: 质量增益幅度很小且“无一致退化”表述偏弱，缺少更严格的统计显著性与最坏案例分析
方法主要是对现有选择器的时序改造，独立算法创新与跨模型普适性证据仍有限

papers.title_zh: EarlySelectKV：通过跨层查询代理进行预期 KV 选择
papers.summary_zh: 查询条件稀疏 KV 选择通过在每个解码步骤关注历史 KV 条目的子集来减少长上下文推理成本。现有选择器必须等待目标层查询，然后才能对候选者进行评分并生成索引，将路由置于直接预注意路径上。我们引入了 EarlySelectKV，这是一种免训练的转换，它使用来自早期隐藏状态的代理查询来预先计算选定的 KV 索引，同时保留真正的目标层查询以进行最终关注。 RocketKV、Quest 和 Loki 的测试显示，在评估的设置中没有一致的质量下降模式。在主要的 RocketKV 评估中，ES-RocketKV 在 LongBench 上相差 +0.018 个百分点，在 RULER 上相差约 -0.01 个百分点，在代表性 NIAH/Passkey 设置上相差 +0.25 个百分点。在具有 CPU 卸载路由的 TensorRT-LLM 部署中，ES-RocketKV 将端到端输出吞吐量提高了 12.4%，并将组合 KV/K-summary 池的 GPU 驻留内存减少了 11.1%。这使得路由时序成为稀疏长上下文解码中 KV 子集选择的显式优化目标。代码可在 https://github.com/sea-with-sakura/EarlySelectKV 获取。

papers.title: Seeing What Matters, Verifying What Pays: Load-Adaptive Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
papers.summary: Speculative decoding accelerates vision-language model (VLM) inference without altering the output distribution, yet two factors limit its gains. Existing drafters either lack the image evidence required for visually grounded tokens or pay to condition on every visual token, although a short draft block typically depends on only a few image regions. Moreover, the value of verifying additional candidates varies with GPU load, so no fixed verification structure is efficient across serving conditions. We present Uni-LaSpec, a block-parallel speculative decoding framework that addresses both factors. To improve draft quality, Uni-LaSpec reuses the verifier's own attention: the query retained from the preceding verification ranks the cached, int8-quantized visual keys, and a cross-layer vote selects a few visual tokens that the drafter fuses through gated cross-attention. Acceptance-aware training further weights each draft position by its contribution to the accepted prefix. To allocate verification, a marginal-cost criterion selects the structure per request and per round: draft trees exploit idle verifier capacity under light load, whereas a dynamic head truncates linear drafts under heavy load. Across six VLMs from three model families and 17 text and multimodal benchmarks, selecting eight visual tokens retains at least 98.6% of the acceptance obtained from the full image at sub-millisecond selection cost. With greedy decoding at concurrency one, Uni-LaSpec achieves up to 5.11x text and 3.24x multimodal throughput over autoregressive decoding. Across six load levels and three GPU types, it outperforms autoregressive decoding in every setting and matches or exceeds the best fixed verification strategy in 123 of 144 settings; under bursty arrivals, it reduces mean end-to-end latency by 47.6% relative to linear verification.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 问题切中痛点，方法完整且实用价值高。
pros: 提出负载自适应验证分配，将系统负载显式纳入推理优化决策
跨多模型、多基准、多GPU和突发流量评测，性能提升与稳定性证据较充分
cons: 摘要未交代训练与在线选择的额外工程复杂度及最坏情形收益下界，部署成本风险仍需量化

papers.title_zh: 看到什么重要，验证什么值得：视觉语言模型的负载自适应推测解码
papers.summary_zh: 推测性解码可在不改变输出分布的情况下加速视觉语言模型 (VLM) 推理，但有两个因素限制了其增益。现有的起草者要么缺乏视觉基础标记所需的图像证据，要么为每个视觉标记进行条件付费，尽管短草稿块通常仅依赖于几个图像区域。此外，验证额外候选者的价值随 GPU 负载的不同而变化，因此没有固定的验证结构在服务条件下是有效的。我们提出了 Uni-LaSpec，这是一个解决这两个因素的块并行推测解码框架。为了提高草案质量，Uni-LaSpec 重用了验证者自己的注意力：从前面的验证中保留的查询对缓存的 int8 量化视觉键进行排名，并且跨层投票选择起草者通过门控交叉注意力融合的一些视觉标记。接受感知训练进一步根据每个选秀位置对接受前缀的贡献来加权。为了分配验证，边际成本标准选择每个请求和每轮的结构：草稿树在轻负载下利用空闲验证器容量，而动态头在重负载下截断线性草稿。在来自三个模型系列的 6 个 VLM 以及 17 个文本和多模式基准中，选择 8 个视觉标记保留了以亚毫秒选择成本从完整图像获得的至少 98.6% 的接受度。通过在并发数为 1 时进行贪婪解码，Uni-LaSpec 可实现比自回归解码高达 5.11 倍的文本吞吐量和 3.24 倍的多模式吞吐量。在六个负载级别和三种 GPU 类型中，它在每个设置中都优于自回归解码，并且在 144 个设置中的 123 个设置中匹配或超过了最佳固定验证策略；在突发到达情况下，相对于线性验证，平均端到端延迟降低了 47.6%。

papers.title: Step-dLLM: Adaptive Step-aware Sparse Attention for Efficient Diffusion LLM Inference
papers.summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate tokens in parallel via iterative denoising, but their bidirectional attention prevents the KV caching used by autoregressive models and recomputes the full attention map at every step, incurring quadratic per-step cost. Existing sparse attention methods for dLLMs construct a sparse mask after an initial full-attention warm-up and reuse it for the remaining steps, while allocating the sparsity budget uniformly across heads. We argue both choices ignore key structural properties of attention in dLLMs: empirically, attention patterns are only locally consistent across steps and shift abruptly at certain transitions, and different heads concentrate their attention mass to very different extents. To this end, we design Step-dLLM, which periodically refreshes a block-sparse mask at anchor steps along the denoising trajectory and reuses it within each locally consistent interval, while employing a head-adaptive global budget that more aggressively compresses heads with concentrated attention. Backed by a fused IO-aware Triton kernel for block-sparse attention, Step-dLLM applies to pre-trained LLaDA-1.5 and Dream-7B-Instruct without retraining, achieving a 2.78x end-to-end speedup over dense FlashAttention on LLaDA-1.5 at 8K context with 256 denoising steps and 90% sparsity, while improving the accuracy-latency trade-off over prior sparse-attention methods.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 思路有新意且实用，但证据仍需更扎实。
pros: 抓住扩散LLM跨步注意力局部稳定与突变并存的结构特性，提出锚点刷新机制
结合按头自适应稀疏预算与Triton融合内核，兼顾算法设计与系统落地价值
cons: 摘要未说明锚点选择与刷新周期的理论依据或鲁棒性边界，可能对任务与步数敏感
主要结果集中在少数模型与设定，跨模型、跨长度与不同硬件上的泛化证据不足

papers.title_zh: Step-dLLM：自适应步进感知稀疏注意力，实现高效扩散 LLM 推理
papers.summary_zh: 扩散大语言模型（dLLM）通过迭代去噪并行生成标记，但它们的双向注意力阻止了自回归模型使用的 KV 缓存，并在每一步重新计算完整的注意力图，从而产生二次的每步成本。现有的 dLLM 稀疏注意力方法在初始全注意力预热后构建稀疏掩码，并将其重用于剩余步骤，同时在各个头之间均匀分配稀疏预算。我们认为，这两种选择都忽略了 dLLM 中注意力的关键结构特性：从经验来看，注意力模式仅在各个步骤之间局部一致，并在某些转变时突然发生变化，并且不同的头将其注意力集中到非常不同的程度。为此，我们设计了Step-dLLM，它沿着去噪轨迹在锚步处定期刷新块稀疏掩模，并在每个局部一致的间隔内重用它，同时采用头部自适应全局预算，更积极地压缩集中注意力的头部。在用于块稀疏注意力的融合 IO 感知 Triton 内核的支持下，Step-dLLM 无需重新训练即可应用于预训练的 LLaDA-1.5 和 Dream-7B-Instruct，在 8K 环境下，LLaDA-1.5 上的密集 FlashAttention 实现了 2.78 倍的端到端加速，具有 256 个去噪步骤和 90% 的稀疏性，同时比之前的方法提高了准确性与延迟权衡稀疏注意力方法。

papers.title: Character-Name Concentration in LLM Fiction: Measuring Displacement and Mitigating Repetition
papers.summary: Character names in large language model (LLM) fiction concentrate on a handful of recurrent names such as 'Elara' and 'Elias', a measurable face of AI slop. Existing fixes either require logit access or retraining, or operate per request and cannot control concentration across a corpus. How much prompt-level strategies reduce concentration, and at what cost to name naturalness, has not been systematically measured. We present an empirical study of name-concentration control across eight strategies and introduce speculative naming, a fine-tuning-free method that adapts the draft-verify-reject paradigm of speculative decoding from tokens to names. The method requests candidate name-sets through verbalized sampling, scores them against a SlopTracker that combines a per-model fingerprint with a runtime counter, and selects through a temperature-controlled rule or its strict variant (HARD). We use 20 LLMs to generate 44,782 stories in four languages from text and visual stimuli (88,919 named characters), and measure concentration with a list-free collision metric (Slop Ratio, SR) decomposed into known and emergent components. List-based strategies do not remove slop: static banlists displace concentration to emergent names and more than halve the share of attested real names. Speculative naming removes it: the sampling scaffold alone cuts SR by 89% on average, the dynamic tracker brings the total reduction to 95%, mean collision probability falls from 7.3% to 0.4%, and known-name collisions hold at zero while naturalness stays close to baseline (42-69% attested by language) and within-story collisions drop from 4.3% to 0.2%. The strategy ranking is stable across languages, model families, and name-counting conventions. Name concentration is thus controllable at the corpus level without logit access or retraining; broader creative diversity beyond naming remains open.

quality.label: 较高
quality.verdict: 问题定义扎实，实证充分，但外部效度待验证。
pros: 提出无logit与免重训的语料级控制框架，工程可落地性强
覆盖20模型与多语言多模态输入，指标分解与消融设计较系统
cons: 自然性评估主要依赖“attested name”代理，缺少充分人工偏好评测与长期语料泛化验证

papers.title_zh: 法学硕士小说中的人物名称集中度：测量位移和减少重复
papers.summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）小说中的角色名称集中在少数反复出现的名称上，例如“Elara”和“Elias”，这是人工智能垃圾的可测量面孔。现有的修复要么需要 logit 访问或重新训练，要么根据请求进行操作，并且无法控制语料库的集中度。即时策略会在多大程度上降低注意力，以及自然性的代价有多大，尚未得到系统测量。我们提出了跨八种策略的名称集中控制的实证研究，并引入了推测命名，这是一种无需微调的方法，它采用了从标记到名称的推测解码的草稿-验证-拒绝范式。该方法通过言语采样请求候选名称集，根据 SlopTracker 对它们进行评分，SlopTracker 将每个模型的指纹与运行时计数器相结合，并通过温度控制规则或其严格变体 (HARD) 进行选择。我们使用 20 个法学硕士从文本和视觉刺激（88,919 个命名字符）生成四种语言的 44,782 个故事，并使用分解为已知和紧急组件的无列表碰撞度量（斜率比，SR）来测量浓度。基于名单的策略并不能消除混乱：静态的禁令名单将注意力集中在新出现的名字上，并将经过验证的真实姓名的份额减少了一半以上。推测性命名消除了这一点：仅采样支架就将 SR 平均降低了 89%，动态跟踪器将总体降低到 95%，平均碰撞概率从 7.3% 下降到 0.4%，已知名称碰撞保持为零，而自然度保持接近基线（通过语言证明 42-69%），故事内碰撞从 4.3% 下降到 0.2%。策略排名在不同语言、模型系列和名字计数约定中保持稳定。因此，名称集中度可以在语料库级别进行控制，无需 Logit 访问或再培训；除了命名之外更广泛的创意多样性仍然开放。

papers.title: Fast and Exact Relative-Position Attention via Structure-Aware Kernels
papers.summary: Relative-position attention mechanisms offer compelling alternatives to RoPE across various transformer architectures, delivering superior performance in domains such as audio. These mechanisms typically modify attention scores by adding content-position or bias-position terms. Unlike RoPE, which encodes position via per-token rotations directly on the queries and keys, relative-position terms generally require pairwise offset-dependent computation or lookups, complicating their integration into fused attention kernels and introducing severe memory, bandwidth, and compute overheads as sequences scale. To address this bottleneck, we propose an exact attention algorithm that incorporates additive relative-position terms into FlashAttention-style tiled computation. Our method (1) uses offset-aware tiling to avoid redundant indexing and memory accesses, (2) computes only the necessary key/query-relation products and reuses them across token pairs in both forward and backward passes, and (3) uses offset-based gradient sharding and aggregation, eliminating atomic contention. We provide a unified, efficient Triton implementation across diverse relative-position attention mechanisms and evaluate it against naive and specialized implementations. For 8K-token sequences, our method speeds up the forward (backward) pass by 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$) and reduces peak memory up to 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$) over the strongest baseline for each mechanism, enabling long-context end-to-end transcription that is 1.8$\times$ faster and uses 2.4$\times$ less memory. Our method thus provides a drop-in, hardware-efficient solution for scaling relative-position attention transformers.

quality.label: 高质量
quality.verdict: 工程价值高，若实验证据完备可冲顶会。
pros: 聚焦相对位置注意力长期存在的内存与带宽瓶颈，问题重要且现实
提出与FlashAttention兼容的“精确”算法并覆盖前后向，速度与显存收益幅度大
cons: 摘要虽宣称统一与精确，但缺少对数值稳定性、泛化边界和跨硬件复现实证的细节

papers.title_zh: 通过结构感知内核快速准确的相对位置注意力
papers.summary_zh: 相对位置注意力机制为跨各种变压器架构的 RoPE 提供了令人信服的替代方案，在音频等领域提供卓越的性能。这些机制通常通过添加内容位置或偏见位置术语来修改注意力分数。与 RoPE 不同，RoPE 直接在查询和键上通过每个令牌旋转来编码位置，相对位置项通常需要成对的偏移相关计算或查找，这使得它们与融合注意力内核的集成变得复杂，并随着序列规模的扩展引入严重的内存、带宽和计算开销。为了解决这个瓶颈，我们提出了一种精确注意算法，它将附加相对位置项合并到 FlashAttention 式平铺计算中。我们的方法（1）使用偏移感知平铺来避免冗余索引和内存访问，（2）仅计算必要的键/查询关系产品，并在前向和后向传递中跨令牌对重用它们，（3）使用基于偏移的梯度分片和聚合，消除原子争用。我们在不同的相对位置注意力机制中提供统一、高效的 Triton 实现，并根据简单和专门的实现对其进行评估。对于 8K 令牌序列，我们的方法将前向（后向）传递速度加快 1.8-6.4$\times$ (2.0-21$\times$)，并将峰值内存减少至 2.9-128$\times$ (1.4-54$\times$)，超过每种机制的最强基线，从而实现长上下文端到端转录，速度提高 1.8$\times$，并使用内存减少 2.4$\time$。因此，我们的方法为缩放相对位置注意力变换器提供了一种直接的、硬件高效的解决方案。

papers.title: TRIAGE: Reliability- and Load-Conditioned Escalation for Two-Tier LLM Serving with a Semantic Evidence Judge
papers.summary: Two-tier LLM serving escalates selected requests from a small model to a large one, but prompt-based routers cannot see whether retrieved evidence supports an answer, and they treat the GPU cost of an escalation as constant. We study TRIAGE, which conditions escalation on a post-generation reliability state and on a load-dependent GPU price, and we report both what held and what did not on one A40 serving Qwen2.5-7B and 32B (AWQ) under VLLM. Escalation cost rose 21.9x from 1 to 10 requests/s but showed no monotone dependence on KV-cache headroom, and a pre-registered claim that the reliability state detects corrupted evidence (AUROC>=0.70) was falsified at 0.571, although any prompt-only router scores exactly 0.500 by construction. Post hoc, a semantic evidence judge raised detection to 0.846 (0.926 on never-served items) and predicted wrong small-model answers at AUROC 0.90-0.96 on RGB and three RouterBench model pairs; the resulting cascade stayed within about 3 pp of GPT-4 at 79.5% lower API cost for GPT-3.5->GPT-4, yet fell below random routing for open-model pairs with 2-3x price ratios. End to end, the 7B->32B pair showed only a +2.88 pp held-out gap, so the allocator rightly declined to escalate and the headline is a null that a small pre-launch gate failed to expose.

quality.label: 中等
quality.verdict: 方法务实且实证扎实，但总体收益受限
pros: 明确预注册并报告否证结果，实验诚信与可复现性强
将负载价格与事后可靠性联合建模，揭示两层服务关键失效边界

语义判官改进主要来自事后分析，在线部署稳定性与泛化仍存风险

papers.title_zh: TRIAGE：与语义证据法官一起服务的两级法学硕士的可靠性和负载条件升级
papers.summary_zh: 两层 LLM 服务将选定的请求从小模型升级到大模型，但基于提示的路由器无法查看检索到的证据是否支持答案，并且它们将升级的 GPU 成本视为恒定。我们研究了 TRIAGE，它以新一代可靠性状态和负载相关的 GPU 价格为升级条件，并报告了在 VLLM 下服务于 Qwen2.5-7B 和 32B (AWQ) 的一台 A40 上保持和不保持的情况。升级成本从 1 个请求/秒上升到 10 个请求/秒，但没有表现出对 KV 缓存余量的单调依赖性，并且预先注册的可靠性状态检测到损坏证据 (AUROC>=0.70) 的声明被伪造为 0.571，尽管任何仅提示路由器的构建得分恰好为 0.500。事后，语义证据法官将检测率提高到 0.846（从未提供过的项目为 0.926），并在 RGB 和三个 RouterBench 模型对上预测错误的小模型答案为 AUROC 0.90-0.96；由此产生的级联保持在 GPT-4 的约 3 pp 范围内，GPT-3.5->GPT-4 的 API 成本降低了 79.5%，但低于开放模型对的随机路由，价格比为 2-3 倍。从头到尾，7B->32B 对仅显示 +2.88 pp 的保留差距，因此分配器正确地拒绝升级，并且标题是一个小的预启动门未能暴露的空值。
